pads.title: AGMRC
pads.snippet: AGMRC provides various agricultural topics such as Farm Generations (helping with farm business transition), Pastured Meat Products (information on niche meat production like pastured poultry), and Food Systems (addressing supply chain issues in the food industry). Additionally, it provides resources related to MarketMaker, which is a national network connecting farmers and fishermen with various food-related entities, allowing for farm or business registration, searching for food-industry-related businesses, and access to maps for Organic Growers and Vegetable, Fruit, & Nut Processors. It also features monthly resources like new agritourism resources.

pads.title: AgriMarketing
pads.snippet: AgriMarketing is a platform focused on providing news, insights, and resources for agricultural marketing professionals, covering strategies, industry trends, market analysis, advertising tips, and case studies to improve agri-business marketing. It helps people who works in agriculture industry to keep updated.

pads.title: Digital marketing for agriculture
pads.snippet: This service is provided by Aijia Media on Huinong.com. This solution includes short video and live broadcast operation, backstage management, and product promotion for agriculture products. Prices range from 200 - 500 yuan with different minimum order quantities. Live broadcast data shows metrics like viewers, conversions, and transaction amounts. The company, in Hotan, Xinjiang, has been operating for 2 years and offers services nationwide.

pads.title: xFarm Academy Advanced

tags.name: Digital Agriculture Precision Farming Data Analysis Technology in Agriculture

pads.snippet: The xFarm Academy Advanced course is an online platform that offers training in digital agriculture. It covers topics such as precision farming, data analysis, and the use of technology in agriculture. The course is designed for farmers and other professionals in the agricultural industry who want to learn how to use digital tools to improve their operations.

pads.title: Field Digital Skills: Micro-courses via WhatsApp for farmers
pads.snippet:
This platfrom is developed by the CGIAR Digital Innovation Initiative, offers micro - courses to farmers via WhatsApp. It capitalizes on the growing smartphone penetration, especially in regions like sub - Saharan Africa. Unlike conventional e - learning platforms, it addresses the challenges of self - regulated learning for farmers. Through a meticulous process involving learner profiling, goal setting, and iterative design, it crafts bite - sized micro - courses. These are bundled into learning routes; currently, "Field Digital Skills, Level 1" is available, comprising four courses on smartphone learning essentials.
Farmers can enroll by registering their mobile numbers on the CO - LAB Learning Network. All instructional videos are conveniently hosted on a YouTube playlist, ensuring easy access for learners seeking to enhance their digital skills and improve farming practices through this innovative, mobile - first learning solution.

pads.title: Coursera's ‚ÄúIoT Enabled Farming‚Äù course
pads.snippet: ‚ÄúIoT Enabled Farming‚Äù is a beginner-level course on Coursera. It takes about 4 hours over 3 weeks at 1 hour per week, with a flexible schedule. Learners will understand key IoT components in agriculture, its benefits and challenges, and the significance of a connected farm ecosystem. Skills gained include IoT farming and related concepts, and a shareable certificate is provided. It covers basic knowledge like smart farming fundamentals, IoT integration, sensor applications, etc. It also delves into advanced topics like smart machinery, wireless sensor networks, and predictive analytics for precision farming.

pads.title: MOOC
pads.snippet: MOOC is an online learning platform that is designed to be accessible to a large number of learners via the Internet. It aims to provide high - quality educational content in China. In this solution, it provides a digital agriculture course named 'Remote Sensing Digital Image Processing and Agricultural Applications'. This course is a core one for majors like Geographic Information Science. It focuses on three main aspects: preprocessing of remote sensing images, image enhancement and fusion, and agricultural applications.

pads.title: Agri-CaB
pads.snippet: Agriculture and Food Security Capacity Building Programme. The Programme is expected to enhance the capacities of the relevant national institutions in the OIC Member States in a wide range of areas such as efficient techniques of land, water and livestock management, fisheries and aquaculture and food security. In addition, it serves as a platform where best practices and experiences can be shared and exchanged.

pads.title: GLOBALG.A.P. Capacity Building
pads.snippet: GLOBALG.A.P. is a farm assurance program promoting safe and sustainable agricultural practices worldwide. Its capacity-building initiatives focus on training farmers, agribusinesses, and stakeholders in best practices for food safety, sustainability, and market access. The program includes workshops, training sessions, and resources tailored to local agricultural contexts.

pads.title: Empowering smallholder farmers
pads.snippet: Farrelly Mitchell believe in the transformative impact that smallholders and SMEs can have on the food supply chain and the wider agrifood industry.  Their consultants have extensive experience nurturing the growth and development of smallholder farmers and SMEs. They work alongside governments, NGOs, and private investors to introduce modern technologies, promote sustainable practices, and connect small-scale businesses with global markets.

pads.title: Agriculture Development Program
pads.snippet: S M Sehgal Foundation‚Äôs Agriculture Development Program promotes sustainable livelihoods in India by building capacities of farmers, including women farmers, on improved agricultural practices and new technologies that increase crop yields, conserve water, and improve soil fertility. The team works with small-holder and marginal farmers in rain-fed and irrigated areas to facilitate adoption of advanced and sustainable agricultural practices that include soil health management, climate-smart interventions, crop production management, input-use efficiency, small farm mechanization, water-efficient irrigation techniques, horticultural development, livestock management, and the use of information and communication technology (ICT) in agriculture.

pads.title: Global Network of Digital Agriculture Innovation Hubs
pads.snippet: This initiative by the FAO establishes in-country hubs to support farmers, youth, and women with digital skills and innovative tools. The program focuses on fostering partnerships, improving digital literacy, and creating tailored digital agriculture models based on local needs.

pads.title: Skilling up the Western Balkans agri-food sector: digitalising, greening
pads.snippet: The Western Balkans' agri-food sector, dominated by small-scale businesses, has significant potential. However, it faces challenges in attracting foreign investment and requires modernization through digitalization and sustainable practices. The European Training Foundation's project aims to address these issues by connecting SMEs with innovation actors, facilitating peer learning, and fostering cross-border cooperation. This initiative will help the region's agri-food sector become more competitive and sustainable, preparing it for integration into the EU single market.

pads.title: Agriculture Course Platform by Coursera
pads.snippet: Coursera offers a vast catalog of agricultural courses, covering diverse topics like sustainable farming practices, crop management, livestock health, and agricultural economics. 1  These courses are often designed by renowned universities and industry experts, providing learners with comprehensive knowledge and practical skills. 2  Some popular courses include "Sustainable Agricultural Land Management" by the University of Florida and "Agriculture, Economics and Nature" by the University of Western Australia.

pads.title: E-Learning on Digital Agriculture
pads.snippet: The course "Digital Agricultural Technologies" offered by the World Bank Group's Open Learning Campus provides an in-depth exploration of how digital technologies can revolutionize agriculture. It delves into the concept of Digital Agricultural Technologies (DATs), their potential benefits, and real-world applications. The course highlights the role of data platforms, including open data platforms, in agricultural decision-making. Additionally, it sheds light on emerging technologies like AI, remote sensing, crowdsourcing, and big data analytics, and their transformative impact on the agricultural sector.

pads.title: DigiFarmer Education Platform
pads.snippet: This is an online educational platform that focuses on developing the digital skills of farmers. It aims to help farmers adapt to the digital age and keep up with technological advancements by providing them with the necessary knowledge and skills related to using digital tools and technologies. The platform is likely to offer courses, training materials, and resources to enhance farmers' digital capabilities, such as using smartphones, computers, and other digital devices for various agricultural and business-related activities. It is part of a project funded by the Erasmus+ KA2 program for adult education, which emphasizes strategic partnerships in the development of educational initiatives.

pads.title: GoAgro
pads.snippet: GoAgro is an online investment platform that connects investors with sustainable agricultural projects. It features diverse projects like Agro Porc's "My Digital Pig" where investors can buy NFTs of pigs and track growth and farm conditions. The investment starts from ‚Ç¨500. It uses blockchain for transparency and IoT for real-time data. Aimed at individual investors interested in sustainable development and agriculture, it provides an innovative, low-threshold investment channel, promoting both local agriculture and meeting the demand for sustainable agricultural products in Europe.

pads.title: Digital Farm
pads.snippet:
Digital Farm is an innovative and unique facility with the goal of supporting the digital transformation of agriculture in Serbia, the region, and Europe. It comprises a physical part and a virtual part.
In the physical part, various AgTech solutions like sensors, satellite images, drones, agrorobots, variable rate technology machinery, etc., are set up in the real agricultural production environment at the fields of Krivaja d.o.o. near Baƒçka Topola in Serbia.
The virtual part is the digital platform AgroSense. By using the data collected from satellites, drones, robots, different sensors, and meteorological stations, AgroSense allows for the monitoring of crop conditions and the planning of agricultural activities via mobile phones or computers.

pads.title: Nasekomo
pads.snippet: Nasekomo is a company that produces high-quality protein products from insects, specifically the Black Soldier Fly. They use these insects to convert organic waste into valuable resources like protein meal, insect oil, and fertilizer. This innovative approach promotes sustainable agriculture and reduces environmental impact.

pads.title: ONDO
pads.snippet: ONDO is a cloud-based system that automates irrigation, fertilization, and climate control for various crops. This system helps farmers save time, reduce resource usage, and minimize human error. By providing remote access and 24/7 support, ONDO empowers farmers to optimize their operations and increase profitability.

pads.title: Cropt
pads.snippet: Cropt is an agricultural technology company based in Serbia. It uses artificial intelligence and big data analytics to predict crop yields, estimate risks, and provide actionable insights to farmers. Cropt aims to make agriculture more efficient and sustainable by leveraging technology. ¬†

pads.title: Agrivi AI Engage
pads.snippet: Agrivi AI Engage is an AI-powered virtual assistant designed to help farmers. It provides personalized advice, answers questions, and offers recommendations based on real-time data and expert knowledge. By using this tool, farmers can improve their decision-making, increase efficiency, and ultimately boost their yields.

pads.title: Smart Watering
pads.snippet: Smart Watering: Irrigation Assistant is a digital solution designed to monitor and optimize drip irrigation and fertilization practices. The platform integrates advanced data collection and analytics to ensure precise water and nutrient delivery to crops, enhancing efficiency and sustainability. Tracks water distribution and ensures uniform irrigation across the field. Prevents overwatering or underwatering by providing real-time data and alerts.

pads.title: Digital platform MyKWS
pads.snippet: Digital Platform MyKWS is a digital assistant tailored for farmers to enhance their day-to-day agricultural management tasks. It is accessible as a mobile application, providing a suite of tools and features designed to integrate with the smartphone‚Äôs capabilities.

pads.title: Digital Business Support for Farming Communities
pads.snippet: Cosmic focuses on enhancing farming efficiency and sustainability through digital solutions. The project offers free information and specialist workshops, as well as 1:1 advice, support, and training to help build digital confidence and enable farmers to better manage the day-to-day running of their farms.It provides training in farm management tools for record-keeping and planning, guidance on online marketing to promote farm businesses, and support for adopting advanced technologies like drones and sensors. Additionally, it emphasizes environmentally friendly farming practices, helping farmers improve productivity while maintaining sustainability.

pads.title: Bearflag Robotics
pads.snippet: Bear Flag Robotics is a company that develops autonomous driving technology for farm tractors. By equipping tractors with advanced technology, Bear Flag helps farmers automate tasks like tilling and planting, increasing efficiency and reducing labor costs. Their technology also provides valuable data and insights that can help farmers optimize their operations and improve crop yields.

pads.title: Digitanimal
pads.snippet: Digitanimal is a company that provides GPS tracking solutions for livestock. Their devices allow farmers to monitor their animals' location, health, and behavior in real-time. This technology helps farmers improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance animal welfare.

pads.title: Aerofarms
pads.snippet: AeroFarms is a pioneering company in the field of vertical farming. They have developed a unique aeroponic system that allows them to grow crops indoors, without soil, in a controlled environment. This method offers several advantages: year-round production, reduced water usage, higher yields, improved food safety, and reduced environmental impact. While they have faced challenges, AeroFarms continues to innovate and push the boundaries of indoor farming. Their technology and approach have the potential to revolutionize the way we produce food, offering a more sustainable and efficient solution to global food challenges.

pads.title: Integration of maize high-yield and mechanical grain harvesting technology
pads.snippet:
This solution was led by  Crop Cultivation and Physiology Innovation Team at the Institute of Crop Sciences of CAAS. They used the innovative technology of quantitatively matching the drying performance of maize varieties with regional ecological conditions, enabling low-crushing grain harvest. By integrating this with high-yield cultivation technology under dense planting, they synergistically improved maize yield and production benefit.
The technology has been widely applied and popularized across the country, leading the development of modern maize production in China.

pads.title: Green prevention and control technology system
pads.snippet: The project was led by Prof. Chen Zongmao's research team at the Tea Research Institute. They created a green prevention and control technology system with the "soil solarization method" as the core and "feed attractant" and "black sticky trap" as supplementary. This system has been applied over one million hectares in the main Chinese chive growing areas, solving the harm of Chive gnats and the "poisonous Chinese chives" problem. Additionally, the content also shows pesticide residue differences between dry tea and tea infusion with specific data for substances like DDT, Endosulfan, Chlorpyrifos, Imidacloprid, and Dimethoate.

pads.title: 5G-enabled farming robot
pads.snippet: 5G-enabled farming robot was launched in East China's Fujian province in 2019. It moves in a greenhouse, gathering data about plants and feeding it back to a control room. Developed by the Fujian Academy of Agricultural Sciences and Fujian Newland Era Hi-Tech Co., Ltd., it aims to build "Autonomous running farms." The robot has a round base with wheels for all-directional movement and is equipped with cameras and sensors on its head to detect various environmental factors. High-quality data gathering is the first step, and with AI algorithms under development, it can potentially determine plant health, pest control conditions, and pick fruit in the future. It has been connected to 5G signals from China Unicom for tests, and the ultimate goal is to achieve "manless farms" by deeply integrating the robot into the agricultural process to assist in management decisions.

pads.title: Agmatix: the Sustainability Center
pads.snippet: The Sustainability Center is a platform that helps farmers and agricultural businesses monitor and analyze regenerative agriculture practices and their impact on sustainability. It uses a framework called RegenIQ to measure both the efforts made towards regenerative agriculture (such as specific farming practices) and the resulting outcomes (like improved soil health, water quality, and biodiversity). By tracking these metrics, the platform provides valuable insights to help farmers make data-driven decisions and achieve sustainable and profitable agriculture.

pads.title: Cargill
pads.snippet: Cargill is an American company that has implemented difital systems all throughout its supply chain. This includes: Automated Rib-Chine Saws, Foreign Object Detection Technology, Paperless Food Safety, Quality, and Regulatory System, or Automated Box Handling Systems. For instance, they implemented AI-powered systems in its meat processing plants to optimize operations. The system uses machine vision and AI to monitor the quality of the meat and ensure compliance with health standards, improving efficiency and product quality. Another example is their use of automated meat processing equipments (chainsaw lines) to help separate meat from bone.

pads.title: Agrisource
pads.snippet: Agrisource is an online, free, and open database dedicated to innovations in agriculture, particularly in the context of climate change. While Agrisource itself does not develop technologies, it serves as a platform to connect and share experiences related to climate-smart agriculture. For instance, it features projects like GreenRice, which tests the alternative wetting and drying system (AWDS) in Europe to save water and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

pads.title: Hands Free Hectare
pads.snippet: Harper Adams University engineering staff, along with precision farming specialist Precision Decisions Ltd, set up a‚Äãutomated machines growing the first arable crop remotely, without operators in the driving seats or agronomists on the ground. ‚ÄòHands Free Hectare‚Äô (HFHa) created autonomous machines out of agricultural vehicles bought off the general market and fitting them with an autopilot system intended for flying drones before programming them with open source software. The budget of less that ¬£200,000 was funded by Precision Decisions and Innovate UK.

pads.title: UiPath
pads.snippet: Romania‚Äôs Rural Investing Finance Authority (AFIR) integrated AI to assist farmers in applying for European Union funds, streamlining tasks and enhancing efficiency in accessing financial support. They use robots from software automation company UiPath. The robots take over the time-consuming tasks of tapping state databases to procure land registry and judicial records for farmers, entrepreneurs and state institutions applying for EU funds.

pads.title: Integrated Fisheries Management Solution
pads.snippet:
This solution focuses on monitoring and enforcing a ten-year fishing ban in key river basins in China, such as the Yangtze River. It leverages digital technologies to ensure sustainable fishing practices, conserve biodiversity, and maintain ecological balance. It uses following technologies                 AI Surveillance: Cameras with AI monitor and track illegal fishing in real time.
IoT Sensors: Monitor water quality and fish populations, integrating data for analysis.
Big Data: Analyzes activity patterns and environmental impacts, offering actionable insights.
Command Systems: Real-time alerts and video feeds support quick decisions and agency coordination. It ensures effective enforcement, and sustainable resource management  and supporting real-time decision-making.

pads.title: Solution for forest fire prevention system
pads.snippet: This solution aims to enhance the comprehensive prevention and control ability of forest fires and improve the effectiveness of forest management and protection by applying technologies such as Internet of Things perception, Ndvisensors, artificial intelligence, and spatio-temporal analysis, an all-weather, high-frequency, large-scale three-dimensional intelligent monitoring network integrating multiple means such as satellites, drones, thermal imaging videos, and manual patrols is constructed; a forest fire prevention big data pool including basic spatial databases, forestry thematic databases, and protection databases is constructed; and a forestry and grassland intelligent visualization platform with functions such as fire monitoring and early warning, fire situation judgment, fire fighting command, situation analysis, disaster loss assessment, and fire supervision is constructed.

pads.title: Blockchain Technology in Agriculture
pads.snippet: It is the use of advanced blockchain technology in agribusiness to enhance traceability, transparency, and efficiency across the entire agricultural supply chain. It enables sustainable business practices, reduces waste, and facilitates consumer purchasing decisions and smooth transactions. Blockchain in agriculture addresses key challenges by streamlining data handling for informed decisions and better collaboration, empowering smallholders with direct market access and fair prices, ensuring food safety and quality via data recording and rapid response, and enabling supply chain transparency and traceability for consumers to track product details.

pads.title: AI and Sentinel-2 Satellite Data for Crop Yield Estimation
pads.snippet: This solution is based on the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with Sentinel-2 satellite data to improve crop yield estimation. AI techniques like Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) are used to analyze high-resolution images from Sentinel-2, which capture information about crop health and growth. This data is then used to predict crop yields with greater accuracy. This approach can help farmers optimize resource use, reduce waste, and increase agricultural productivity.

pads.title: Flyguys
pads.snippet: Drones equipped with cameras capture aerial images and videos of fields, forests, and rangelands. Farmers use this technology to monitor crop health, analyze soil conditions, optimize irrigation, and manage forests and livestock. This data-driven approach improves efficiency and reduces costs.

pads.title: RIMpro
pads.snippet: RIMpro is a tool that helps manage pests and diseases in vineyards and orchards. By using weather data from Sencrop stations, RIMpro provides real-time risk assessments for various diseases and pests. This allows farmers to make informed decisions about when and how to treat their crops, reducing the need for pesticides and improving overall crop health.

pads.title: Idroplan
pads.snippet: Idroplan is a comprehensive tool for managing both irrigation and vine diseases. By estimating water stress and predicting water consumption, it helps optimize irrigation practices. Additionally, Idroplan calculates and forecasts risk indices for common vine pathogens, enabling proactive disease management. To leverage the power of localized weather data, Idroplan integrates with Sencrop, allowing users to connect their weather stations and gain valuable insights for improved crop health and yield.

pads.title: Germ of Life
pads.snippet: The Germ of Life project aims to address climate change by monitoring ecosystems and developing strategies for adaptation. CMCC, a key player in the project, focuses on using Earth observation data and advanced analytics to assess drought conditions and their impact on the environment. The project will develop new drought indicators and refine existing ones to improve drought prediction and risk assessment. Ultimately, Germ of Life aims to automate and enhance the process of monitoring soil and vegetation health, providing valuable insights for proactive drought management.

pads.title: Collect Earth
pads.snippet: Google and the FAO have partnered to create a free, open-source tool called Collect Earth. This tool allows farmers to monitor their land over time using satellite imagery. By analyzing historical and current satellite images, farmers can identify changes in vegetation, water bodies, and land use. This information helps farmers make informed decisions about crop management, resource conservation, and responding to climate change.

pads.title: Deforestation monitoring
pads.snippet: Deforestation monitoring solution offers the ability to remotely monitor deforestation in selected areas with high accuracy (90% and higher) using the latest ML technologies. It has flexible areas of interest and custom monitoring periods. The solution utilizes data from various satellites including Sentinel - 1, Sentinel - 2, and EOS SAT - 1 for more precision. It provides downloadable deforestation maps and support from an experienced team of scientists.

pads.title: Zoning API
pads.snippet: The Zoning API offers a solution to build vegetation and productivity maps for variable-rate application of inputs in heterogeneous fields. It enables the creation of productivity maps that measure biomass generation over a selected period to estimate field area productivity. Additionally, it allows for the construction of vegetation maps using vegetation indices to identify the spatial variation and health conditions of vegetation. These maps are essential for enhancing cropland productivity by enabling informed application of fertilizers, seeds, and other inputs.

pads.title: Crop classification
pads.snippet: It offers the ability to determine crop types on a regional scale, conduct crop inventories for any vegetative season, and estimate hectarage. The process combines Sentinel - 2 time - series images with 10 - m resolution and ground data. Neural networks are then applied to detect field boundaries and classify different crop types, with the model achieving up to 90% accuracy (which can vary based on region and input data quality and completeness). The data can be visualized on a map, and users will be provided with completed cropland masks in.geotiff and.shp files.

pads.title: EOS SAT-1
pads.snippet: EOS SAT-1, a satellite by EOS Data Analytics, focuses on multiple applications. It has advanced features like 11 bands, super-resolution, and can cover a large area daily with 1-day revisit. It's used in environment, urban, agriculture, and forestry monitoring. The process involves upstream, midstream, and downstream operations. It benefits various sectors and offers satellite-as-a-service with steps like imagery, analytics, and product integration. Launched in 2023, it helps in making informed decisions and has wide-ranging impacts.

pads.title: Nonglinyun Chicken Farm Management System
pads.snippet:
This system can record detailed information of each chicken, such as breed, date of birth, vaccination history, etc.
The climate monitoring system automatically collects environmental data like temperature, humidity, and atmospheric gas content in the chicken coop. It also has Diet Management which can automatically generate a scientific feeding plan and supply appropriate feed regularly and quantitatively according to the chicken breed and growth stage.
The disease monitoring system monitors the health status of chickens in real-time and can issue a risk warning in a timely manner when abnormalities are detected, reminding managers to take measures.

pads.title: Farmable
pads.snippet:
Farmable is a digital platform designed to streamline agricultural practices and enhance efficiency. It offers a range of features to support farmers in various aspects of their operations, including:
Smart Planning and Monitoring: Farmers can utilize real-time data insights to optimize crop planning, monitor growth stages, and allocate resources effectively.
Regulatory Compliance: Farmable simplifies adherence to European regulations by providing tools for documentation, traceability, and reporting, reducing administrative burdens.
Data-Driven Insights: By analyzing historical data, farmers can identify trends, mitigate risks, and make informed decisions to maximize profitability.
Collaboration and Connectivity: The platform fosters collaboration among farmers, agronomists, and industry associations, enabling data sharing and communication to promote a community-driven approach to agriculture.

pads.title: Agri-IoT
pads.snippet: Agri-IoT is a company that operates throughout the African continent,  coming up with different digital solutions. Among different products, you can find a soil carbon dioxide content sensor, that monitors soil CO‚ÇÇ levels to help understand soil respiration and microbial activity, crucial for soil health and crop growth. You can also find Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR) Sensor, which measures the light available for photosynthesis, ensuring crops receive optimal sunlight for growth.

pads.title: The Connected Farmer Alliance (CFA)
pads.snippet: The Connected Farmer Alliance (CFA) is a partnership between USAID, Vodafone, and TechnoServe to improve the lives of smallholder farmers in Kenya, Tanzania, and Mozambique. By using mobile technology, the CFA aims to connect farmers to markets, financial services, and agricultural information. This will help farmers increase their productivity, incomes, and resilience to challenges like climate change. The CFA is currently working with 30,000 farmers and multiple agribusinesses to achieve these goals.

pads.title: PoultryMon
pads.snippet: Big data from sensors for remote monitoring and process monitoring for poultry hatchery operations. The system delivers real time, consistent process monitoring through every level of hatchery/Farm operations. It uses IoTs to deliver detailed hatchery overview,management,analysis & reporting on mobile.

pads.title: PADI-web
pads.snippet: The Platform for Automated extraction of animal Disease Information from the web (PADI-web) is an automated biosurveillance system devoted to online news source monitoring for the detection of emerging/new animal infectious diseases by the French Epidemic Intelligence System. The tool automatically collects news via customised multilingual queries, classifies them and extracts epidemiological information. PADI-web pipeline involves six steps ranging from online news collection to the extraction of epidemiological features: data collection, data processing, data classification, sentence classification, information extraction, user notification. This strategy has been used in the implementation of several projects at national and European levels (see their website).

pads.title: Smart Paddock
pads.snippet: Smart Paddock is a GPS technology used to track cattle. The Pulse Dashboard translates data captured by Smart Paddock products into actionable insights about your animals, assets and farm. From there, one can send alerts to their team, update statuses and attend to any urgent tasks.

pads.title: AeroFarms
pads.snippet: AeroFarms uses indoor vertical farming strategy paired with artificial intelligence and plant biology. They use specific LED lighting to create a custom light algorith and have specific spectrum, intensity, and frequency which controls the physical and flavor components of the crops. The controlled indoor environment disrupts the normal cycle of indoor pests. This pest-resistant design prevents the use of pesticides.

pads.title: NADAMS
pads.snippet: NADAMS project, developed by National Remote Sensing Centre, provides near real-time information on prevalence, severity level and persistence of agricultural drought at state/ district/sub-district level. The assessment is carried out using rainfall, Remote Sensing Vegetation Index and Moisture adequacy Index during the Kharif season. Since its inception, the NADAMS project has seen numerous improvements in methodology and technology. These advancements include the use of moderate resolution data for more detailed assessments, the use of multiple indices for drought evaluation, and the synchronization of ground observations with satellite-based interpretation. The system now provides user-friendly information through the following methods: 1. Utilizing multiple satellite data, 2. Analyzing rainfall indicators, 3. Examining soil moisture index, 4. Conducting ground observations.

pads.title: IRRIOT
pads.snippet: IRRIOT applies IoTs to drip irrigation systems. Sensors in the field monitor the temperature, soil moisture, even the pH level of the soil. They send that information via a radio signal to a remote terminal unit in the field, which then sends it to a controller, which is essentially a computer. The remote terminal also opens and closes the valves on the irrigation system. The third part of the system is cloud software, the intelligence that processes the data and knows when to send the correct commands to the controller. IRRIOT sells RTU, mobile application/cloud, and controllers. For the moment, the company has two pilot installations on strawberry fields.

pads.title: AgriFin Accelerate
pads.snippet: AgriFin Accelerate is a US$25 million, six-year initiative funded by the Mastercard Foundation. It aims to help smallholder farmers in Kenya, Tanzania, and Zambia access financial and information services. The program works with farmers and various stakeholders to identify barriers to access and develop solutions to overcome them. It utilizes technology and mobile banking to improve farmers' access to financial products and services, ultimately increasing their productivity and income.

pads.title: Esoko
pads.snippet: Esoko is an agricultural technology company thta provides tools and services to hep smallholder farmers connect to markets and access information. It provides up-to-date information on market prices for crops, and also gives access to accurate weather forecasts to help farmers plan their harvesting nd planting schedules. Esoko also provides expert advice on best practices for farming, including crop management, pest control and soil health. Through Esoko, farmers can receive important updates and alerts via SMS, voice messages or interactive voice response (IVR) systems.

pads.title: AcreTrader
pads.snippet:
AcreTrader is a platform that helps farmers buy and sell farmland. It offers high-resolution satellite imagery and data analytics to provide detailed insights into land quality, crop performance, and soil health. This combination of real-time data and marketplace features makes it easier for farmers to make informed decisions when purchasing or selling land, while also optimizing current farm operations.
Key features:
Buy and sell farmland with detailed property listings.
High-resolution satellite imagery for crop and soil monitoring.
Real-time data on land performance and field conditions.
Alerts for potential crop issues based on satellite data.

pads.title: Intelligent aquarium pumps
pads.snippet: An intelligent solution for aquarium pumps. It features remote control, energy-saving, fault alerts, and smart timing. The Wi-Fi DC PUMP CONTROLLER uses an ESP32-C3 module with specific hardware specs like DC 24V power supply and working in -20~70‚ÑÉ. It offers up to 100 controllable gears and supports pumps up to 200V power. It provides free public software for four-terminal control, including WeChat mini-program and apps for different systems. It also has features like feeding time setting and calibration. Brand customization services are available with UI/UE design, and it supports integration with major voice speakers. It is compatible with various pump types.

pads.title: XAG agricultural drones
pads.snippet: This solution utilizes XAG agricultural drones (e.g., P100 Pro) and the XAG Wisdom Agricultural System in citrus orchards. Drones address terrain issues, save labor (up to 83.3% reduction), enhance spraying with features like high efficiency and adjustable atomization, and improve fruit quality. The system monitors environmental data, analyzes soil, controls irrigation, uses remote sensing for mapping and guiding drone operations, and enables convenient orchard management, ultimately enhancing efficiency, cutting costs, and promoting digitalization and industry transformation.

pads.title: Climate FieldView: Precision farming technology
pads.snippet:
Climate FieldView delivers deep insights into farm operations, helping farmers tailor fertility and seeding plans for optimal yield across different field zones.
Key features:
Tailored fertility and seeding plans.
Cross-device availability for easy access.
Yield optimization through field variability analysis.
Digital tools for efficient resource management.

pads.title: CropX: Advanced soil and irrigation insights
pads.snippet: CropX integrates hardware and software to deliver real-time soil, water, and crop condition monitoring, making irrigation and soil management more efficient. CropX is an easy-to-use yet powerful agronomic farm management system that uses AI and machine learning to connect farm data, real-time conditions and agronomic knowledge, providing guidance for successful and sustainable farming, while aggregating all agronomic farm data in one place for easy tracking and sharing.

pads.title: Robs4Crops
pads.snippet: Project set up by the European Union in three European countries by implementing three different types of robots: 2. Autonomous robots/tractors with a sensing of environment, localisation and navigation that are able to communicate with smart implements. 3. Planning and scheduling software. The Farming controller uses Digital Twin technology for pro-active and reactive planning and scheduling. They have so far run projects on mechanical weeding in vineyards, table grape spraying, apple orchard spraying, and mechanical weeding in arable crops.

pads.title: Bushel Farm
pads.snippet: A farm management software, helps farmers make informed decisions and manage resources efficiently. It offers a comprehensive view of farm operations and finances, with features like tracking unsold grain prices, providing real-time price alerts, and reducing manual entry. It also manages costs and profits by summarizing expenses, integrating with other platforms to sync data for production cost calculation and profit tracking. Additionally, it provides convenient functions such as rainfall notifications and has an intuitive design that is easy to use and affordable, earning positive farmer reviews for improving operations and aiding decision-making.

pads.title: Agrivi: 360 farm management software
pads.snippet: Agrivi empowers farmers with data-driven decision-making tools, and real-time insights from the field to make precise agronomic and economic decisions and maximize productivity and profitability.

pads.title: Cainthus
pads.snippet: Technology that allows for computer vision and deep learning to monitor animal behaviour. It is an AI camera used for facial recognition and behavioural patterns of cows to answer questions like: are they eating, standing, sleeping, drinking, etc. This data is used to monitor and analyse health, environmental, production factors. More generally, big data analytics techniques can be used to aggregate and integrate data across farms in order to optimize production processes and systems.

pads.title: Global Partners Benin
pads.snippet: Project that implements drones for improving rice and pineapple productivity in Benin. First, the first category of drones used are smart spraying drones to dispense pesticides more effectively and safely. Second, the project also equipped extension workers with drones generated data that deliver innovative, location specific and real time advice to farmers.

pads.title: Tend
pads.snippet:
Tend offers a comprehensive platform for crop planning, record-keeping, and operational management, helping farmers streamline tasks like sales records and harvest workflows.
Key features: Crop planning and task management, Sales and inventory tracking, Harvest workflow tools.

pads.title: Digital Marketplace for Fish Farming in Madagascar
pads.snippet: The Sustainable Aquaculture in Madagascar project has launched a digital marketplace to connect fish farmers with buyers. This marketplace uses a hotline and SMS notifications to facilitate transactions. The project has also launched an awareness campaign to promote the use of the hotline.

pads.title: Sansheng's Intelligent Control System Platform
pads.snippet: It can collect various environmental and equipment data, such as soil temperature and humidity, EC/PH value, air temperature and humidity, etc., and analyze and apply the data. It can automatically alarm and push notifications, and realize real-time viewing and management of equipment status. After setting parameters, it can automatically start the well pump and valves in sequence to achieve intelligent rotational irrigation. It also has functions such as well pump phase loss protection, water level protection, automatic water replenishment, constant pressure water supply, group control, and linkage control. Additionally, It can automatically replenish water or stop irrigation according to the set upper and lower limits of soil moisture, and can also operate in combination with rainfall forecasts.

pads.title: DC Agriculture
pads.snippet: This is an online wholesale platform driven by data and technology, integrates regional supply resources, and offers one-stop procurement, wholesale, and distribution services for agricultural products across the region, constructing a fresh food supply chain for a win-win situation. It includes supply from direct-purchase bases and manufacturers, order processing, stocking, group-buying and flash sales through the DC agricultural middle platform, shared logistics scheduling, third-party logistics distribution.

pads.title: Cattlytics
pads.snippet: A single, all-encompassing cattle tracking software that allows complete visibility and control over your daily cattle operations. With a single, user-friendly app, you can track cattle movement in the fields and at various locations. It gives detailed field views, plans the pen‚Äôs exercise of the cattle and any other activity they carry out promptly, and logs the history of the cattle‚Äôs records. Cattlytics is a comprehensive livestock management app created for your needs on a cow farm. The Cattlytics appallows farmers to monitor their livestock. It saves time-consuming paperwork that would otherwise be associated with it.

pads.title: AgroSignal.Farm Management Platform
pads.snippet: Maintains operational plans and schedules: automates all reporting processes related to working the land, setting staff shift schedules, creating individual and group plans and reports for equipment operation, resource allocation, cargo movement, and security. When integrated with the 1C system, waybills are automatically generated in 1C based on data on completed work and the output of machine operators, which is automatically loaded from the AgroSignal system.

pads.title: AgroBot
pads.snippet: The project ¬´AgroBot¬ª is a system of autopilot agricultural equipment. This solution allows you to automate a significant part of field work, make them faster and more accurate, eliminating the human factor. operates 24/7, which increases the efficiency of the use of agricultural equipment; reduces the costs of farmers and agroholdings for fuel; optimizes the cost of maintaining equipment; increases yields, and also contributes to the development of agricultural land in areas remote from infrastructure and in difficult climatic conditions.

pads.title: Intelligent greenhouse control system
pads.snippet: The intelligent greenhouse control system by Sciento is an advanced solution. It can remotely access environmental data like soil temperature, humidity, CO2 concentration, and video images. It controls greenhouse equipment such as wet curtain fans, drip irrigation, and shading systems through data model analysis for optimal crop growth. The system offers over 60 types of sensors and control devices, continuously monitors various environmental parameters, and can expand monitoring points. It has features like intelligent monitoring with multiple alarm options, intelligent control of common equipment, and remote control via mobile and computer. Compared to traditional management, it reduces production risks, saves labor costs, and increases production efficiency.

pads.title: Modern Agriculture Platform
pads.snippet: MAP is positioned as an "agricultural value chain co-creation and sharing platform", building a bridge between consumption upgrading and new-type farmers, and providing the whole industry chain service that combines online and offline and covers the whole process of agricultural production and sales for the vast number of growers and food value chain partners.It helps farmers increase income, improve industrial efficiency, and bring benefits to consumers, leading the development of agricultural modernization and digital innovation.

pads.title: GrainPro¬Æ TranSafeliner Bulk‚Ñ¢
pads.snippet: The GrainPro¬Æ TranSafeliner Bulk‚Ñ¢ is a solution for protecting and preserving the quality of dry agricultural commodities during shipping in ISO containers. It is made of high-strength polyethylene with a proprietary barrier layer and uses woven tape and nylon string for installation. It has good gas and moisture shielding properties to prevent insect infestation, condensation effects, and mold growth. The stored commodities can be safely preserved during trans-oceanic transit or storage when used with a strong polyethylene woven bulkhead.

pads.title: GrainPro¬Æ Cocoon‚Ñ¢
pads.snippet: GrainPro¬Æ Cocoon‚Ñ¢ is a flood-protected and hermetic storage solution amis to reduce food loss and waste. It is made of flexible UV-resistant Polyvinyl Chloride, guards against rodents, and prevents air and moisture exchange. It allows for chemical-free storage and long-term preservation with the ability to monitor internal oxygen and relative humidity. It has an inlet port for convenient Gas Hermetic Fumigation (GHF), specifically designed for CO‚ÇÇ fumigation. Product specifications include details on material (PVC), thickness, product life, and capacities ranging from 0.6 MT to 300 MT with corresponding bag capacities and dimensions provided.

pads.title:
Capacity Development
to better manage agricultural risk
pads.snippet: A platform for Agricultural Risk Management (PARM)'s activities in Ethiopia which is organized by International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), aiming to enhance the country's agricultural risk management. It includes knowledge sharing and learning platforms: the use of blended (physical and virtual) learning cycles and workshops for capacity development and knowledge sharing. It has brought multiple benefits to Ethiopia, such as strengthening agricultural risk resilience, aiding knowledge sharing and capacity building and facilitating policy integration and practice

pads.title: KAIPOS Weather Stations
pads.snippet: KAIPOS Weather Stations is a system that provides real-time weather data tailored for agricultural use. These stations collect a variety of environmental metrics, including temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind speed, and solar radiation. The data collected supports better decision-making for farmers, enabling them to optimize irrigation, protect crops from adverse weather, and manage resources more effectively. KAIPOS stations also allow data visualization and can send alerts to help farmers take timely actions based on weather conditions.

pads.title: Big Data Analysis and Decision-making system
pads.snippet: This system offers data display from production to sales in agriculture, providing services like overall monitoring and various analyses. Through big data and AI, it shows key industry indicators and sends warnings. It also remotely monitors farms in real-time, guiding production with AI analysis, and has a quality monitoring system for regional agricultural products.

pads.title: The Open Forum on Agricultural Techonology in Africa (OFAB)
pads.snippet: The Open Forum on Agricultural Biotechnology in Africa (OFAB) is a project that aims to increase understanding of agricultural biotechnology in Africa. It does this by facilitating conversations between policymakers, scientists, and the public. OFAB provides accurate information and promotes the benefits of modern biotechnology, such as increased crop yields and resistance to pests and diseases. By engaging with key stakeholders, OFAB helps to inform policy decisions and advance the use of biotechnology in African agriculture. It also includes the establishment and management of a range of platforms to enhance understanding of biotechnology in agriculture for productivity.

pads.title: TAAT Maize Compact
pads.snippet: The AATF-led TAAT Maize Compact is spreading climate-resilient maize technologies, including Water Efficient Maize Varieties (WEMA), to 14 African countries. This collaboration between public and private sectors involves seed companies, farmer organizations, commodity associations, and national agricultural research institutions.

pads.title: Farmers Business Network
pads.snippet: This solution provides farmers with services such as agricultural market information and agricultural product sales. Its digital platform can help farmers understand the market price trends of agricultural products, obtain suggestions from agricultural technical experts, and at the same time provide an online sales channel for agricultural products to help farmers expand the market.It features products, aims to cut costs, boost profit potential, enable informed decisions, offers shopping/delivery, financial services, sustainability options, and shares relevant news.

pads.title: Smart Silo
pads.snippet: Service for monitoring the maturation and storage of silage in silo trenches. Smart Silo offers a unified approach to monitoring using a heat map of the trenches, determining the stage and type of the fermentation process and determining the possible shelf life of the silo, the order of use of the trench

pads.title: ALAN IoT Application
pads.snippet: A service for collecting, receiving, transmitting and processing data from various devices, monitoring incoming information, analyzing data received from devices and systems, working with users, setting up and sending various notifications, displaying information and current data from devices on a map.

pads.title: PEWS
pads.snippet: The PEWS pastoral surveillance and early warning system has been developed by the NGO Action Contre la Faim in the Sahel region where pastoralism and pastoral mobility are one of the keys to environmental and economic resilience. The approach aims to monitor pastoral resources based on satellite images complemented by field data collection and combines two concepts: early warning and surveillance. Early warning is based on the evaluation of biomass production during the rainy season, allowing the anticipation of the stock of pasture that will be available during the next dry season. Surveillance is done through real-time monitoring of green and dry vegetation by remote sensing and a network of field agents, who provide information on the pastoral situation at the local scale several times a month. The project uses phone apps such as 'Pastonavigator' or mapping systems such as MODIS (Moderate-Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer).

pads.title: WaPOR
pads.snippet: Satellites and Artificial Intelligence for the development of agricultural geoservices (land-crops-water) for the production of agricultural data (Crops and Water) and land (parcellization) and the monitoring of irrigation: Demo Project in the Oum Er Rbia Basin. The project is part of the exploitation of new generations of Time-series of satellite images with high and very high spatial resolutions, WaPOR databases developed by FAO and Deep Learning algorithms for the automatic delimitation and agricultural management of plots, in particular the automatic recognition of crops, monitoring of water needs and drought monitoring.

pads.title: CarbonFarm
pads.snippet: CarbonFarm harnesses satellites and AI to monitor and certify decarbonisation projects at scale. CarbonFarm's services include satellite monitoring of practices, quantifying greenhouse gas emissions, managing the carbon certification process, and finally, brokering the credits on voluntary carbon markets. They do not work directly with farmers, but instead with agribusinesses, rice buyers, carbon credit developers, governments and others that have direct access to farmers and built-in trust from them.

pads.title: The NextGen Agroadvisory
pads.snippet: The NextGen Agroadvisory is a location-specific, tailored, and season-smart agricultural decision support tool (DST) designed to help farmers make informed decisions about fertilizer application, planting timelines, and other agricultural practices. The tool uses machine learning algorithms to analyze crop responses to different fertilizer inputs and spatial co-variants, providing recommendations tailored to specific locations and growing conditions.

pads.title: Smart Greenhouse
pads.snippet: Service for monitoring, analysis and forecasting in greenhouses, which can calculate dependencies and identify key factors affecting the quantity and quality of crops grown. This service provides a forecast of future productivity, can evaluate the quality of the crop, taste of the fruit, predict costs and optimize costs

pads.title: Dairy Production Analytics (DPA)
pads.snippet: DPA is a specialized agricultural technology solution designed to help dairy farmers monitor, manage, and optimize milk production. Using real-time data and analytics, DPA systems provide insights into various aspects of dairy farm operations, such as animal health, milk yield, feeding efficiency, and overall herd productivity. These solutions are typically used to enhance decision-making, improve animal welfare, and increase operational efficiency in dairy farming.

pads.title: Sciento
pads.snippet: This system consists of 4G DTU, cloud server, and DS - 500 application software platform. It can real-time collect and monitor various agricultural data such as air temperature and humidity, light, rainfall, wind speed, wind direction, atmospheric pressure, PM2.5, noise, and gas concentration. It also supports customized monitoring of elements. By setting relevant alarm thresholds for the equipment, it can achieve instant alarm and precisely control the planting environment indicators.

pads.title: FarmERP
pads.snippet: FarmERP is an agritech platform that offers end-to-end farm management solutions designed to improve the efficiency and productivity of agricultural operations. The platform integrates various features that support farm activities, including crop planning, pest and disease management, weather analysis, inventory and financial management, and sustainability reporting.

pads.title: –êgromon
pads.snippet:
Agromon is a unique plug-and-play device that enables Smart Agriculture. It is incredibly easy-to-use, as it practically needs no configuration at all. By simply plugging in the sensors included in the package, the device is ready for use. However, other sensors and devices are also available to be interfaced with Agromon, according to the user‚Äôs needs. Wireless communication is based on Sigfox, LoRa, or WiFi.
Agromon is based on ESP32-WROOM-32, which is a powerful, generic Wi-Fi & Bluetooth/Bluetooth LE module that targets a wide variety of applications, ranging from low-power sensor networks to the most demanding tasks, such as voice encoding, music streaming and MP3 decoding. On top of these, ESP32-WROOM-32U also has a U.FL connector.

pads.title: Exact-Farming
pads.snippet: A platform that unites digital agronomy solutions for agricultural producers, manufacturers and sellers of fertilizers, agrochemicals and seeds, financial institutions and other participants in the agricultural industry, allowing them to effectively manage agribusiness, make timely decisions, reduce risks and increase the transparency of interactions with each other. ExactFarming combines satellite imagery, weather data, and soil analysis to offer insights that improve crop yields, resource efficiency, and overall farm productivity.

pads.title: AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS TESTING
pads.snippet: This solution offers an agricultural products testing service. It partners with authoritative institutions, has a wide testing range and strong ability. Serves various clients, provides comprehensive and customizable services including testing, equipment, lab design, training. The process involves multiple steps, results usually in 5 days (with express option), and tests for pesticides, veterinary drugs, heavy metals, additives, etc.

pads.title: Gizwits AIoT
pads.snippet:
Gizwits has 16 years of IoT R&D experience and developed a one-stop solution for freshwater aquaculture. It has three layers:
Perception Layer: Features intelligent hardware and sensors like aerator controllers, dissolved oxygen meters, etc., enabling remote control and real-time data collection for farmers.
Platform Layer: Utilizes IoT for data transfer, and big data and AI for analysis. It uncovers key factors and offers suggestions for better decision-making.
Application Layer: Has a mini-program for farmers to manage multiple devices, view data, and receive alerts. The system also provides services for equipment enterprises.

pads.title: Hi Saai: Artificial Intelligence Platform for Family Farmers
pads.snippet: Hi Saii is a platform designed to help farmers by providing instant answers to their questions via WhatsApp. The platform uses a vast amount of data to provide comprehensive advice on various farming topics, including business planning, financial management, crop production, and more. Saai aims to make this technology accessible to farmers worldwide, particularly in developing countries. While the platform is still in its development phase, it has already proven to be a valuable tool for farmers.

pads.title: Chanjet's ERP system for animal husbandry
pads.snippet:
This system has features including:
Financial Management: Good Accounting for data handling and Yidai Zhang for proxy accounting, supporting multiple methods and generating statements.
Procurement Management: ERP module for comprehensive functions with Good Business for inventory, planning, and supplier management.
Sales Management: Good Finance and Business for automated sales and strategy formulation.
Production Management: Good Business module for production process digitalization.
Supply Chain Management: Good Finance and Business module for connecting and coordinating production, sales, and resources.

pads.title: AgriWebb
pads.snippet:
AgriWebb's Individual Animal Management offers 5 features:
1. Centralized Data: Unlocks animal and grazing insights in one place, enabling better decisions and breaking data barriers.
2. Hardware Integration: Connects with EID and other hardware, saving time and filling data gaps.
3. Informed Decisions: Allows data-backed real-time choices, such as calculating stocking, optimizing rotations, and identifying underperformers.
4. Reports: Includes reports for better grazing management, such as exact feed on offer, grazing days remaining, pasture growth rate, and stocking rate.
5. Profit Maximization: Helps increase profits by identifying overperformers, filtering by traits, leveraging land, and knowing market readiness.

pads.title: Easyv
pads.snippet: This solution features an operation dashboard for data analysis and sales management. It can address challenges in agricultural product sales due to data variability and complex entities. It offers a tracing mechanism, shows scheme effects like hot-selling goods analysis, and has advantages such as increasing benefits, upgrading the industry, reducing risks, and efficient design.

pads.title: Revolutionizing Wine Production with WiTWINtake
pads.snippet: This project aims to revolutionize wine production by establishing a system that improves the grape intake process and quality grading. It uses video cameras at grape intake points for enhanced grape quality grading based on video footage, streamlining and improving key winemaking steps. It also enhances traceability by linking the final product (wine) back to the vineyard, it represents a significant advancement in the wine industry, leveraging technology to improve efficiency, quality, and traceability.

pads.title: Smart Vertical Farms in Korea
pads.snippet: Young Korean start-ups are developing smart vertical farms to tackle two main issues: lack of space and growing demand for fresh food. By using ship containers, repurposed warehouses, tunnels, and subway stations, businesses are now growing vegetables without the need of pesticides, sunlight, and soil, away from natural pollution, and with 90% less water usually needed in traditional farming. With a mix of IoTs, AI, and hydroponic technologies, these farms have the potential to become an unprecedented source of food for millions of people living in a metropolis.

pads.title: Smart tea garden solution
pads.snippet: It's a digital platform integrating decision-making, production, traceability, and culture. Highlights include a data center, digital supervision system, ecological prevention and control. It also covers equipment, traceability management, services for farmers, and brand building.

pads.title: AGRIVI's traceability and supply chain solution
pads.snippet: AGRIVI offers a solution for traceability of own/contracted crop production, with benefits like supply chain integration, contract tracking, quality assurance, risk mitigation, customer transparency, and a marketing tool. It also has products like AGRIVI Food for traceability and the farm management software for sourcing.

pads.title: Agroberza
pads.snippet: As the official website of thePublic Enterprise Agroberza, it establishes connections and offers mediation in offer/demand of products among producers,traders and processors in the agricultural and food production sector. The website gives some information about certain products‚Äô prices.

pads.title: Agrometeo
pads.snippet: The Agrometeo system is a weather and disease forecasting tool that serves the regions of Kochani, Strumica, and Gradsko in North Macedonia. It provides real-time information on weather conditions, issues alerts for the development of specific crop diseases and pests, and offers basic data on several prevalent plant diseases.

pads.title: Real-time Meteorological Stations
pads.snippet: These stations are designed to provide up-to-the-minute weather data for these regions, supporting agricultural activities, research, and local planning by delivering precise meteorological information.

pads.title: Climate FieldView
pads.snippet: The Climate FieldView‚Ñ¢ is developed by Climate Corporation. It uses satellite imagery to help farmers identify crop diseases and monitor field health.This tool helps identify issues such as nutrient deficiencies, pests, and diseases early in the growing season, allowing for timely interventions.

pads.title: Plant health database
pads.snippet: This is a database,provided by UNILAB from the ‚ÄúGoceDelchev‚Äù University, offers information about complex structures of diseases,pests and weeds, and appropriate pesticidesfor different culture groups (fieldcrops, vegetables, fruits, viticulture).

pads.title: The Agricultural Market Information System (ZPIS)
pads.snippet: Is an essential tool for gathering and disseminating data related to agricultural markets. Launched to improve market efficiency and provide farmers with timely information. Aims to enhance transparency in market operations by providing real-time information on prices, supply, and demand for various agricultural products. This system plays a crucial role in supporting farmers, traders, and policymakers in making informed decisions based on current market conditions

pads.title: Macedonian Soil Information System(MASIS)
pads.snippet: MASIS is designed to gather and organize various data related to soil characteristics, including texture, pH, and salinity, which can be crucial for informing agricultural practices and policymaking. The system aims to help stakeholders make evidence-based decisions to promote sustainable agriculture and manage soil resources effectively. MASIS will also make it possible to monitor soil condition and determine how human interventions, such as land use changes and climate change, affect it.

pads.title: Aquamaof
pads.snippet:
Aquamaof offers closed loop aquaculture solutions using Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS). Key features:
Closed loop: Efficiently treats and reuses water, reducing consumption.
Monitoring: Uses sensors to monitor environmental conditions in real time.
Sustainability: Minimizes pollutant emissions and risk of disease.
High productivity: Allows for dense fish farming at lower costs.
Flexibility: Suitable for a variety of aquatic species.

pads.title: Agrinoze
pads.snippet:
Agrinoze‚Äôs proven plant resource management solution is the first fully autonomous & automatic system for the market. Agrinoze increases crop yields by hundreds of percent, saves water and fertilizers, and improves soil health.
The groundbreaking algorithm, machine learning and holistic approach has been tested and validated by numerous projects globally; consistently delivering reliable and scalable results while continuously leveraging data for even better, more precise, and efficient irrigation and fertigation.
The system enables the automatic defining and profiling of the soil in each project to provide for the specific requirements, constraints and needs ‚Äì developing, planning, implementing, deploying, and monitoring 24/7.

pads.title: Electronic agro-industrial trade portal ‚Äì ‚ÄúMarketplace‚Äù
pads.snippet: The users of the trade portal are farmers, agricultural producers, large clusters, agro-logistics centers, processors, small and large retail chains. "Marketplace" is especially relevant for residents of settlements with few financial services and low-mobility categories of agricultural producers. In the future, this platform will be used to conclude export contracts and develop agricultural exports.

pads.title: Geographic Information System
pads.snippet: This agricultural monitoring system uses satellite images updated every 10 days and data from 200 field workers for real-time analysis. The system provides complete information on landowners, soil properties, irrigation systems, and AI-powered analysis for automatic crop recognition.

pads.title: MazaoPlus+
pads.snippet: MazaoPlus+, an innovative data platform created to collect and share fertilizer supply and demand data (e.g., fertilizer price, fertilizer type, etc.) among smallholder farmers and fertilizer vendors with the aim of improving market inefficiencies. Using a USSD code, farmers get information on fertilizer vendors closest to them, who are selling the type of fertilizer that they are looking for. In addition, farmers get to know different fertilizer prices either per 50kg bag or per unit kilogram.

pads.title: FarmGrow
pads.snippet: The FarmGrow app is used to record soil properties (i.e., soil physical condition, organic matter condition, pH, and drainage) and related soil management observations (i.e. fertilizer application and formulation) from the top 30 cm of the soil at each farm site. The aim is to provide site-specific soil information that smallholder cocoa farmers can use to improve soil health and overall farm productivity.

pads.title: Digital farm
pads.snippet:
On-farm NEXO weather stations: provide real-time data information that is integrated into the FarmDirect App to analyse data (temperature, humidity, light intensity and soil temperature data).
Farmdirect app (logbooks) and dynamic data dashboard: enables smallholders to visualise and track the profit and loss across multiple on-farm enterprises, to access a portal with information and data (eg: from weather stations or other external data-sets).

pads.title: Na√Øo Technology
pads.snippet: Na√Øo Technologies develops, manufactures and markets autonomous robot for agriculture in close collaboration with farmers. These solutions tackle farm worker shortage, reduce the strenuous physical workload and limit the use of chemical weed killers.

pads.title: The Living Lab: Mirafiori Sud
pads.snippet: Mirafiori Sud is a neighborhood in the city of Turin that used to be a working middle-class area with a population of over 40.000 people. Thanks to European funds and a project called ProGlreg, the neighborhood has gone through a green renovation, where old abandoned industrial buildings and former railway lines have been turned into parks, green corridors, etc. The area has turned into a hub for start-ups and business innovation, with different nature-based solutions (NBS) that contribute to the urban regeneration of what once was an automotive industrial centre. Among NBSs, there are community-based urban farms and gardens, green walls and roofs, and pollinator biodiversity. The project ProGlreg is being implemented in different cities of Europe, and in the city of Ningbo, China, as well.

pads.title: The Agrometeorology Net of Piemonte (RAM)
pads.snippet: A monitoring system of the regional agricultural territory of Piemonte utilizing a net of meteorological stations that gather and store the climate history of the territory of over 10-15 years. Over the course of the years, this system has become integral to support the productive processes, currently using 120 stations (63 government-owned). Data is collected into databases through GPSs or GPRSs, and it can be consulted on the website for free (only for up to 30 days prior).

pads.title: Combination of GPS and agricultural sensors
pads.snippet: This technology involves sensors, GPS, big data, and IoT. Integration of these enables better management including precision fertilization and water control, and environment adaptive strategies. Future trends focus on the development of agricultural IoT and AI assisted decision making.

pads.title: Algae air pollution cleaners
pads.snippet:
The BioUrban 2.0 system developed using filters and microalgae allows cleaning the air of pollutants such as carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxide and PM particles (10 and 2.5) to convert them into oxygen and biomass, benefiting the health of people who interact in the area.

Each BioUrban developed by the company BiomiTech can carry out the work of approximately 368 mature natural trees; it costs approximately 60 thousand dollars and its operation is based on the so-called green technology, designed for the urban and interior sector.

pads.title: Recicletas
pads.snippet:
El 15 de marzo de 2023 Marea Verde inauguró el proyecto “Recicletas”junto con la Junta Comunal de Don Bosco y Recicladora Nacional de Panamá. Las Recicletas son bicicletas modificadas con vagones de acopio que recolectan material reciclable de puerta en puerta en los hogares de las comunidades de Terremar y Bello Horizonte en el corregimiento de Don Bosco.

El diseño de las “Recicletas” busca generar modelos de acopio y recolección domiciliaria que estimulen la correcta clasificación, acopio y reciclaje de desechos para que luego estas conductas se conviertan en hábitos en la población. 

Para la construcción de las Recicletas se adquirieron bicicletas montañeras y se modificaron con vagones construidos con materiales rescatados localmente. Las estructuras se fabricaron a partir de tubos de acero de antiguas estanterías descartadas; las ruedas, ejes y chumaceras de segundo uso fueron adquiridas de talleres de motocicletas; la articulación son puntas de flecha rescatadas de un taller de mecánica automotriz en Las Acacias; las bolsas jumbos o “bigbags” fueron donadas por la empresa CALESA en Aguadulce y la mano de obra fue realizada por herreros, soldadores y pintores rehabilitados y en búsqueda de una resocialización por adicción en la Asociación REMAR a través de sus talleres en Chilibre.

Ante los problemas de una deficiente recolección, la opción es quemar o arrojar los desechos en lugares no autorizados, creando graves problemas de salud y medioambientales. El proyecto busca el aprovechamiento de los materiales reciclables, promover su correcta disposición y prevenir problemas de salud generados por la falta de opciones de eliminación de desechos. Los residuos recolectados se transportarán a la instalación de acopio para ser reclasificados, pesados y compactados.

Las “Recicletas” son un ejemplo de cómo, con recursos limitados, ingenio y creatividad, se pueden generar soluciones a problemas como la falta de sistemas de acopio para reciclaje de materiales valorizables, reducir el volumen de basura generada y evitar la contaminación de ríos, quebradas y océanos.

La idea es que el proyecto pueda ampliarse a otras comunidades de difícil acceso y replicarse en cualquier lugar del país ya que el mismo no emite gases de efecto invernadero y tiene muy baja huella de carbono.

pads.title: Produce delivery for community resilience
pads.snippet: The COVID-19 pandemic led to a decrease of economic activity in Sleman, Yogyakarta. Due to the measures taken to mitigate the impact of the pandemic, buying and selling activity at local markets came to a standstill, as many people were no longer able to freely visit the marketplace. Sayur Sleman, a local small enterprise, was established in response to these conditions. This startup offered vegetable delivery services, acting as a middleman connecting market vendors and households in need of fresh produce. The communication between customers and the service took place through digital means such as WhatsApp and social media apps. In addition, Sayur Sleman launched an alms-giving program, distributing free produce to people in need as a way to give back to the community, as well as a program to teach farming and entrepreneurial skills to locals. The activities of Sayur Sleman demonstrate the impact that digitalization and MSME development can have towards building community resilience.

pads.title: Titir Cetar: Local community-based disaster resilience platform
pads.snippet: Titir Cetar is a web-based platform designed to strengthen the disaster preparedness and response of the residents of Tegal Regency, Central Java. Users can find information regarding evacuation routes, emergency response facilities, and a disaster risk map on the platform, as well as report any disaster events to the authories. Local communities, including schoolchildren and housewives, were included in the design and development process of this platform. The site has been adopted by the Regional Agency for Disaster Countermeasure (BPBD) of Tegal Regency, and holds the potential for scaling, both at the local level in other regencies, as well as at higher levels.

pads.title: Natural breakwater
pads.snippet: The neighborhood of Kesunean is a coastal community in the city of Cirebon, and as such, they are prone to coastal flooding and high tide. Such events have the potential to bring seawater into the homes of residents, pollute streams and sewers with litter, and create debris which is left on land as the water retreats. Residents responded by constructing a simple seawall along the coast using bamboo as well as a breakwater made of used coconut husks. These can last a couple of years and are useful in preventing coastal erosion. Given that both materials are biodegradeable, this is a nature-based solution. But at the same time, the material is also readily available in the area and easy to find. Therefore, such an approach to mitigate coastal flooding can be easily scaled and replicated in other locations in Indonesia and beyond.

pads.title: Communal water well
pads.snippet: This water well was identified near a market in Larantuka, East Nusa Tenggara. While there is open access towards the well, there are also numerous pipes stemming from the water source, which leads to individual houses in the vicinity of the site. According to locals, anyone can collect water free of charge, however, households that live nearby can opt to install dedicated private pipelines at their own cost. This initiative demonstrates the importance of strong social systems and high trust in building community resilience, particularly in an area prone to droughts and depletion of water supplies. In the nearby island of Timor, the UNDP Indonesia Accelerator Lab has also observed communal responses to floods and water disasters that reflected community-based resilience, which stems from a common understanding that members, old and young, must help one another.

pads.title: Uyway
pads.snippet:
The 'Empowerment Program for Elderly Women Weavers' is an initiative focused on providing support and opportunities to elderly artisan grandmothers who possess unique skills in hand weaving. The main objective of this program is to reactivate the economy of these older women by providing them with resources, training, and access to specialized markets for the commercialization of their creations, specifically baby textiles. Distribution takes place in specialized stores with which partnerships have been established, facilitating the placement and sale of the products woven by the grandmothers in these spaces.


After the sale of the products, payment is made to the grandmother weavers according to a fair and transparent scheme that recognizes their work and contribution to the empowerment program. Additionally, UYWAY is responsible for acquiring the necessary materials for the production of the textiles, ensuring their quality and facilitating access for grandmothers who may have mobility issues or limited resources.

pads.title: Confirming: Financiamiento de cuentas por cobrar.
