pads.snippet: Reliable company that allows to contribute to the environment by using resources: Reduction, Reuse and Recycling of materials; thus generating goods and services, for a lasting future without pollution. It is dedicated to the recovery and recycling of plastic materials.

pads.title: Giving plastic a second life
pads.snippet: Ecoplast is characterized by the creation of furniture and household items made from 100% recycled plastic. One of the outstanding characteristics is the durability of the materials used, in addition to being environmentally friendly. Ecoplast has a wide variety of raw materials of the highest quality for the national and international industry.

pads.title: Whistles to stop and prevent violence against women, teenagers and children
pads.snippet: Photograph: Red Mesa de Mujeres The organization Red Mesa de Mujeres from Ciudad Juárez is promoting neighborhood support groups and the use of whistles to call the attention, prevent and stop acts of harrasment, violence and potential danger against women, teenagers or children. The whistle is distributed along with flyers and other items that have the telephones of police and authorities. The sound will be an alert signal to call for support and to try to disinhibit the attacker while the authorities are called to 911. The whistle is relevant because often the police can take a long time to answer and alternative means of support are required. "Although we are confined by the pandemic and we wear masks, we must not remain silent when we see acts of violence ” –Isabel Aguilera González, neighbor and promoter of the Riberas del Bravo neighborhood network.

pads.title: Al Barakeh Wheat
pads.snippet:
Towards a Self Sufficient Jordan: New Wheat Growing Project Launches in Amman

"Do you want to learn how to grow wheat in the capital, Amman, from start to finish? Do you want to plant your wheat and have enough stock for about a year? Want to know the different products and foods we can make from wheat grain other than flour? Do you know that Jordan imports 97% of its wheat and grains needs and that it is the main source of energy and calories for Jordanians?"

With these questions Rabee Zureikat, founder of Zikra Initiative, started calling people in Amman to join a new project to grow wheat, inspired by the lockdown and necessity to have a stock of food to sustain oneself and family at all times.

pads.title: Platform - MyCity
pads.snippet: The main motivation of GREEN HUMAN CITY is a broad unification of activists and ordinary citizens behind specific projects within the framework of thematic efforts.  These projects are generated through three sources: 1. The expertise of the activist organizations that make up ZHG 2. Citizens' proposals on the MojGrad platform, created and administered by ZHG, and 3. The demands of the protest movements in which ZHG participates ZHG's goal is to integrate projects from these three sources and to represent them as policies in local institutions, in parallel with an agenda for progressive institutional transformation aimed at transferring power from the political and business elite to the citizens. Thematic efforts: Urban mobility, Animal protection, Clean environment, Energy independence, Sustainable development, Social justice Organizational principles: Horizontality, Inclusiveness, Transparency

pads.title: Digital Platform - Dialogue with EU
pads.snippet: The project CSO Dialogue – Platform for Structural Participation in EU Integrations aims to facilitate meaningful and structured participation of the civil society that expresses the views of citizens, to impact key sector reforms in the EU accession process. The platform offers a opportunity for structural participation of the civil society in institutional consultation mechanisms, thereby increasing availability of information and support for participation in policy-making related to the EU accession process.   The platform has the following functions:  1. conducting research to measure involvement and participation of the civil society; 2. organizing events and public consultations; 3. monitoring the work of sector working groups by developing analyses and reports; 4. designing visual charts on key conclusions from work of sector working groups in order to improve information dissemination to citizens about this process; 5. production of video materials, educational videos, tutorials, and the like; 6. drafting a declaration on transparency of the negotiations process; 7. streaming meetings of the Council for Cooperation between the Government of RNM and Civil Society; 8. organizing annual conferences around the issue of civil society participation in sector policy creation and implementation

pads.title: First bicycle square in Skopje - Velostad

pads.title: Digital Registration for Civil Society Organizations
pads.snippet: The Central Database for Foreign Aid at the Government of the Republic of Northern Macedonia enables registration of all projects / donations in Northern Macedonia financed with non-refundable funds from foreign donors (grants / donations) for which there is an appropriate Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Northern Macedonia and the foreign donor.  Agreement is for the purpose to enable easier registration of the assistance in order to ease the procedure for exemption from customs, excise and other import duties and / or exemption from value added tax (VAT) on trade in goods and services, in the procurement of goods and services, as well as import of goods and equipment is envisaged. for the needs of the project / donation. The procedure is initiated by the entity in charge of project implementation. To start this procedure, the implementer must first request the project / donation to be registered in the Secretariat for European Affairs, ie in the Central Database for Foreign Aid - CDAD at the Government of the Republic of Northern Macedonia.

pads.title: Biogas Solution: Farmers turning cows' manure into energy (creating the perfect closed loop)
pads.snippet:
With minimum resources available, Mr. Atef Azkoul is making generating biogas from cows’ manures.  He learnt about the method through the internet and started applying the experiment within his farms using a basic digester.

Because of the high prices of gas and fuel, biogas provided the perfect solution for a raising challenge.

Moreover, Mr. Azkoul is creating the perfect closed loop by using manure to generate energy and using the remaining liquid as a fertilizer, liquid compost. The compost is applied to crops which are then fed to cows who produce the manure that is used in the “digester” for biogas. 




Mr. Atef is one of many farmers from different Syrian provinces who are following the same practise.

pads.title: On your Way, Waslni. Transportation digital solutions. Social media platforms and  applications
pads.snippet: With the increased transportation costs in Syria and the imposed sanctions that affects mobility services, a number of local solutions and initiatives were started in different Syrian provinces. Most of these solutions depended on the concept of sharing transportation costs. It started with people starting a public Facebook page where drivers/ cars owners can post their destinations, time of trip, number of available seats and cost of the trip (sometimes they offer free rides).    Recently a number of start- ups created mobile applications that offers mobility as a service. But still the informal Facebook pages covered a wider population, more options, and cheaper costs.

pads.title: Biorremediación de agua
pads.snippet: Innovators: Universidad Nacional Santiago Antúnez de Mayolo Río Santa Ana community members (Canrey chico) Instituto de Montaña Rivers and other sources of water which farmers and communities depend on are polluted or have been negatively impacted from mining. Heavy metals in water poses an important threat to health and the environment. The Río Santa community in Perú has been trained in: analizing its water sources with the use of simple technological devices and use a filter system which consists of different water ponds with filtering plants and rocks. Polluted water travels and passes by filtering ponds and levels before arriving to farms or before community use. Communities chose the filtering plants to be used, which generate a bacteria that reduces metal pollution. Water becomes usable for agricultural purposes (not drinking).

Esta iniciativa contó con la participación de más de 150 fincas y aproximadamente 400 participantes entre agricultores/as, almacenistas, niños y niñas de Isabela, Santa Cruz y San Cristóbal, quienes asistieron a los talleres y fueron parte de la minga desarrollara en octubre del presente año para la recolección de este tipo de desechos.

pads.title: Amazon cooperative entrepeneurships
pads.snippet:
La asociación, que se encuentra ubicada en la región de la Amazonía ecuatoriana, ofrece 4 emprendimientos en las áreas de turismo comunitario, elaboración de jabón artesanal, aprovechamiento de madera a través de un taller de carpintería y un vivero forestal.

Sin embargo, debido a la emergencia sanitaria por la COVID19, la asociación se centró en la elaboración de jabón artesanal con la ayuda del PNUD. Anteriormente los emprendimientos estaban a cargo de la comunidad, pero por temas de política de cada gobierno se conformó una asociación para el manejo de todos los emprendimientos.

Su principal diferencia se evidencia en la asociación comunitaria, donde todos los ingresos recaudados por la elaboración y venta del jabón artesanal son compartidos con todos sus socios y socias de forma equitativa. Dentro de las buenas prácticas se encuentra el trabajo en conjunto con socio bosque y PNUD en el tema de la elaboración de jabón. Esta idea inició hace 7 años a través de capacitaciones y ayuda con recursos e insumos por parte de un voluntariado.

El principal impacto de este emprendimiento es el trabajo que se realiza con los jóvenes para que formen parte del proyecto y mantengan su operación en el futuro. Además, busca tener un impacto positivo en la comunidad al generar ingresos y medios de vida de manera sustentable.

pads.title: Citizen science on the marine environment: "El Veril del Banco de Afuera"
pads.snippet: Description of citizen participation: The idea behind "El Veril del Banco de Afuera" (Outer Bank Reef) lies in the collaboration between the National Institute for Fisheries Research and Development (INIDEP in Spanish) and the "Escualo” Underwater Activities Center (CASE in Spanish) diving club in collecting information on the marine environment in order to coordinate an integrated monitoring effort towards the evaluation of possible changes linked to ocean acidification in the coastal site of Mar del Plata.   CASE scuba divers collect seawater samples (for the analysis of pH levels and total alkalinity, salinity, dissolved oxygen, chlorophyll-a, phytoplankton and bacterioplankton abundance) during their recreational outings to "El Veril" (a coastal site visited by divers due to its good visibility and variety of marine species) on a semi-monthly basis. They also record the metadata required at the sampling site (GPS coordinates, date and time, sampling depth, the dive computer temperature profiles, and sea conditions).

pads.title: Citizen science on cyanobacteria and water bodies eutrophication: "CYANO"
pads.snippet:
Description of citizen participation: Citizens participate in workshops, visual monitoring, data interpretation and communication. The Spanish acronym stands for the following:

· Control: Monitoring of cyanobacteria and other ELM water quality aspects, with systematized measures and adequate space-time resolution

· Y (and): The nexus involving citizens, research teaching staff, and students of FCEFyN-UNC.

· Alert(alert): After processing field data, supplemented with lab data, the risk levels associated to cyanobacteria exposure are informed to schools, decision-makers, and society.

· Niveles (levels): A risk level is assigned, and recommendations are made for different water uses.

· Observados (observed): Personnel from the Search and Rescue Group of Calamuchita and citizens perform visual monitoring at ELM.

pads.title: Citizen science on technical and diagnostic assessment on urban floods: "COINCIDE: DPLUS"
pads.snippet: Description of citizen participation: The community offers valuable insight into the basin behavior, which is combined with the technical expertise of the research team to produce a conceptual model of the system operation. Both hydrometeorological (rainfall) and hydrological data (flows draining through the streets) must be recorded for this. Additionally, citizens collaborate to define pertinent locations for collecting hydrological data. Different solutions are also proposed in collaboration, working on their sustainability and feasibility, both to be presented to the corresponding governmental institution and to be applied by the community. The research team in charge of the project receives the records created by the community. Reports are created, published, and sent to the community following the record validation

pads.title: Oxygen distribution
pads.snippet: Oxígeno CDMX is a project to share updated information every day to buy, rent or recharge oxygen tanks in Mexico City and Toluca. The site shares information on oxygen distribution companies that may be filtered by location, price, availability, payment information, The initiative was born from the need to provide the population with updated information on the sales and rental network of oxygen cylinders, since the saturation of hospitals in Mexico City has forced thousands of people infected by the virus to treat the condition from home and access to oxygen was becoming complicated. It was started by students of the National Politechnic Institute and has since been supported by the  Digital Agency for Public Innovation (ADIP) of the Mexico City Government, which now is looking into conneting it to other public services and information related to COVID attention.

pads.title: Soap from coffee leftovers
pads.snippet: After using the coffee to make cold brew the leftovers are used to make soap that can be used as body scrub and exfoliation. This leads to decreased waste production.

pads.title: Incinerator-no fume & no smell
pads.snippet: This incinerator was developed by Bio Energy Team, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, the National University of Laos. The team participated in the Youth Innovation Challenge Promoting Circular Economy in Waste Management which was organised by the UNDP Accelerator Lab in 2020. This incinerator uses electron to capture the microparticle. It is proven to be able to burn some waste without generating fume and smoke.

pads.title: An app that motivates walking and riding a bike
pads.snippet: Created by active members of the community and application called "Challenger" that rewards points with witch you can get discounts in certain stores or cafes. The points are earned by walking or riding a bike.

pads.snippet: A sustainable organization for social innovation called ARNO.mk produced these cards that contain flower seeds that later can be planted.

pads.title: Nopal (prickly pear) gasoline / fuel

According to the promoters, prickly pear biogas has proven more effective than sugar or corn biogas. pads.title: CAC, when environment, positive attitude and motivation make ONE
pads.snippet: Sur image vous avez une plaque communément appelée dallette (dalle de terrasse)  qui est un ensemble composé de plastiques collectés des déchets dans la  ville de Boké. le plastic chauffé est liquéfié et ainsi malaxé au sable avec une proportion bien définie pour garantir la solidité mais aussi le cohérence entre les différents agrégats utilisés. la solution est ensuite recueillie dans des moules de différentes formes selon le design souhaité. Sur le plan environnemental, cette solution représente un moyen certes de recyclage, de création de richesse et d'auto employabilité des jeunes étudiants sans emploi regroupés en coopérative dénommée Coopérative Action Citoyenne.

pads.title: Yéro Kanté, A will against a fate for a better tomorrow!
pads.snippet: Yéro Kanté, a man who was not in his childhood favored by nature to be scolarized had the humility to get to work and by the strength of these points succeeded in building a school intended to train the younger generations of the city of Kamsar and by extension those of Guinea. Yero Kanté is a REAL HERO!!!

pads.title: Yéro Kanté, the man with the hands of steel!
pads.snippet: - Shipwreck off Kanfarandé: 14 dead, one missing and 15 injured. - Guinea-Conakry: at least 15 dead in the sinking of a boat - Kamsar: the sinking of a canoe leaves 3 dead and 15 survivors. These are the tragedies facing which the authorities and residents of Kamsar have long remained unarmed.  Coming from a predominantly modest community, Yéro Kanté, will address the thorny question of finding a viable and lasting solution to the safety of the populations during the various crossings. Thus, with the sole strength of these arms coupled with the enthusiasm of the love of good, he will succeed in bringing together all the elements necessary mostly composed with the recycled metals for the design of a boat. To this day Yéro Kanté, like a true genius who started from nothing, has a naval fleet to his credit. his solution is a local option for the revalorisation of metals in the era side of Kamsar and by the same mean, a long term factor of saving peoples lives.

pads.title: Yéro, the Hero of palm oil producers.

tags.name: the vulnerable members of our society

pads.snippet: Again he, yes him, Yéro Kanté, here he takes on the savior of palm cultivators in the sense that given the difficulty of these in extracting oil properly and therefore to market on a large scale due to the fact that it required transport to processing plants which were excessively expensive, at least for the average producer. Our friend Yéro kate has designed a machine that crushes palm kernels and extracts the oil, bark and seed separately. This solution is of three types: one manual, two other motorized but respectively medium and large capacity. To date, Yéro has managed to make a good situation thanks to the sale of this solution which is very popular with our average growers and which finally allowed him to reach neighboring countries so as to facilitate the sale of his productions. .

pads.title: Helicopter of Yéro; from dream to reality!
pads.snippet:
I met an incredible metal genius who succeeded in following all the laws of aerodynamics by building a model helicopter from a visualization. 
In Guinea and particularly in Kamsar, there is a man by the name of Yéro Kanté, never educated but who has to his credit creations worthy of an engineer of great schools. Yéro by viewing a helicopter, will bring together all the equipment necessary to make this dream come true. Beyond the physical design, he will meet pilots who will not hesitate to provide him with everything he needs to learn, understand and master all the interdependencies linked to the dynamics of the helicopter. This is how yéro will put everything on its side, with the support of a team of young people guided by the strong desire to see the dream come true; to collect metals, weld them together, make a rotor and hand-crafted propellers and finally buy a motor which will serve to provide a driving power drive to the whole. After days of hard work, Yéro will be congratulated by his friends and almost all the inhabitants for his achievement

pads.title: IST Electric Management System
pads.snippet: If you are looking for a solution to control your electricity consumption and, in turn, lower your bill at the end of the month, this is indeed a device that will please you. it is a circuit assembly designed to adapt switching on and off by means of an SMS which you can send from any point on earth. Let's say it's an executor of will dictated through the short messaging system ....... For the moment this solution is in full swing and could well be available very soon on the market. This is also designed by the team of IST of Mamou.

pads.title: The IST Surge protection
pads.snippet: Guinea, a country located on the west coast of Africa is endowed with a high rainfall, and has a vast network of rivers which earned it the name of water tower of Africa. A wealth taken advantage of by the government by the construction of certain dams for the provision of drinking water and electricity to the populations. However, the obsolescence of the circuits used to transport electricity, the use of certain alternatives such as generators, thunder, to name but a few, cause enormous losses for the population both in human lives and with regard to household electrical equipment. To respond to this problem, our research team at the Mamou IST center has set up a device to cut the circuit when the voltage level no longer corresponds to that expected in the circuit. This device is practically operational and will be available for low-income households.

pads.title: IST Compact sanitary protection kit
pads.snippet: While everyone held their heads on the issue of covid, Guinea, through its team of engineers from the IST institute in Mamou, set to work hard and ended up designing a device for KRAPOS name which means: Automatic Sanitary Protection Kit, whose role is to Test and Prevent covid-19 disease, by aggregating the following functionalities: Scanner for the temperature level, hand washing with a reservoir integrated soap and drinking water, hand drying after washing and finally, a water level indicator to deal with any possible shortage.

pads.title: IST cell culture incubator
pads.snippet: like the eye incubator, to make it easier for our many doctors in remote areas, the IST of Mamou has taken the time to research and finally design this discovery which will allow all cells to be kept at the desired temperature. targeted to promote their production and from this point guarantee a rapid response in this area. Our design is able to operate on solar energy as well as electric.

pads.title: The IST smart trash can
pads.snippet: In prototype, we present to you the intelligent trash can designed by the students of the IST of Mamou. Beyond the normal function of trash which is used to collect garbage, our students have just set up a formula that allows to aggregate the automation of opening, closing, transmission of alert sms with automation of the extinction made available against probable fires.

pads.title: The IST Eggs Incubator
pads.snippet: To meet the strong market demand for eggs, some entrepreneurs are investing in poultry production. Thus, it represents a proven growth activity. However, faced with the lack of sufficient electrification of suitable production areas, our students from IST de Mamou have succeeded in developing an alternative solution that allows several eggs to be hatched at the same time with the possibility of being supplied with electricity from a double source by solar panel and mains.

pads.title: Automatic electric alternator
pads.snippet: in this image, we find an automated alternation solution guaranteeing a phase change between the mains current source and that of the solar panel. This solution is a creation of the promotion of students of the year 2019 from the Institute of Sciences and Technologies IST of Mamou.

pads.title: Edama Organic Solutions - Organic Waste Recycling Solutions for Desert Environments
pads.snippet: Edama Organic Solutions are the leading entity in creating a local circular economy that recycles organic waste into high-value products for desert agriculture in Saudi Arabia. They align social, environmental and economic targets set by Saudi Arabia's vision and the Sustainable Development Goals. Founded by 4 young innovators from different backgrounds, their journey started in 2017 at King Abdullah University for Science and Technology (KAUST), where they built their first composting pilot facility and since then they have been testing and improving their processes and products taking advantage of the scientific expertise of their team and the KAUST core-labs facilities. In 2018, they won the SAAB-funded Taqadam accelerator program competition from a cohort of over 400 start-up teams from all across Saudi Arabia.  In 2019, they expanded their composting operations and established strong relationships with key stakeholders and customer segments.  In 2020, they obtained seed funding from the KAUST Innovation Fund and secured their first contract for designing, building and operating a commercial-scale composting facility with recycling capacity of 11,000 tonnes, which will become operational in Q3 2021 (August). By 2022 they expect to build 3 additional recycling facilities, and by 2025 their goal is to reach 3M tonnes of organic waste recycling capacity. Edama directly addresses food security, water scarcity and pollution issues.

These tote bags have a cultural social impact but also environmental, i.e. in the sense that these bags will be made for large surfaces to minimize the use of single-use bags. https://web.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100027452456406

pads.title: Aya Hamioud Project
pads.snippet: A project which consists in using a product resulting from the manufacture of butter, which is (buttermilk), it is considered as a waste rejected by dairy factories in Algeria and which is one of the most important causes of pollution of the water in the country. Its use is very wide, either in food (cheeses, creams, juices, etc.) or in cosmetics. The solution: by taking it up in many factories and combining it with the oil produced by recycling poultry products, Aya will make a natural soap that is useful for the skin and even the hair.

pads.title: Green Sewing
pads.snippet: Green Sewing is a socio-environmental startup that aims to recycling tarpaulin advertising posters into products unique creative and eco-friendly (Shopping bag, Pencil case,backpacks ...). The project responds to the problem identified, namely the absence of promotion and use of advertising posters (tarpaulins) after their expiration, and the lack of sustainable alternatives. Our environmental impact is manifested in the fact that we give a second life to a material at the end of the cycle to produce new reusable and sustainable products to encourage people to stop using plastic bags for a single use, on the other hand we help housewives and low-income women by ensuring them a job and a salary.  https://web.facebook.com/Green.sewing.4/videos/1093601367745275

pads.title: Organic Fertilizers from shrimp shells
pads.snippet: Chitosan Egypt is a Pioneer EG + MENA biotech company expert in manufacturing high competence chitosan and Chitosan solutions for all sectors. The start-up was born from one of the UNDP Egypt innovation lab's Hackathons. Chitosan Egypt is specialized in manufacturing a raw material called chitosan which they use in farms to convert conventional farming to organic farms, getting rid of more than 500 tons of shrimp shells waste yearly in Egypt by making organic agri products, also helping more than 300 families in Fayoum governerate whose only income comes from shrimp peeling.  https://chitosaneg.com

pads.title: Fresh Source
pads.snippet: Co-founded by Farah Emara and Omar Emara.  Fresh source is a tech B2B start-up that aims to serve as a connection between farmers and urban retailers/vendors. FreshSource is disrupting the Egyptian horticulture agri-chain through the provision of innovative solutions that are aimed at integrating small-time farmers into the modern value chain. FreshSource is taking a value chain approach to improve the economic and environmental efficiency of the food supply chain in Egypt where the food waste has reached an all-time high at over 30% due to improper handling and storage techniques. Through the platform the company aims to collect and analyse data on market demand and prices, enabling a more strategic and market driven approach to crop production planning.

Es una iniciativa para hacer frente a riesgos de violencia que viven las mujeres, tanto pasajeras como conductoras. Se va creando una red de confianza y clientas frecuentes.

pads.title: Energy ball
pads.snippet: Creado por Ronny Velastegui, Dalena León, Emilia Iglesias, de la Universidad  Yachay, Ecuador. El  prototipo, la base es de madera, mientras que la esfera es de plástico rellena de plástico. Usaron una botella que tomaron en la basura, de las que se emplean en las peluquerías para echar gel u otras sustancias. La esfera sirve como una lupa", intensificando la llegada de los rayos del sol sobre el panel solar. Además de intensificar, su forma circular hace que los rayos solares se enfoquen en un solo punto, independientemente de la dirección en la que estos lleguen, optimizando la energía solar. pads.title: Wind resistant vineyards
pads.snippet:
This is how vineyards grow on Canary Island in Lanzarote where there is no irrigation system and very little rainfall, with strong winds.



The small island has more than 300 volcanoes and therefore the place is mixed with a lot of ash.
Grape saplings are planted specifically in dug pits or, alternatively, a rock wall is placed around the sapling. This is done to make it easier for the roots to reach the fertile soil layer and to maintain the moisture of the grapes. This system works well considering that there is very little rainfall, no artificial irrigation, the plants are fed from the dew, that is concrentraed in the walls of the cones around it.

pads.title: Kawon Cultural Library
pads.snippet: Kawon Cultural Library was created by Ghaith Bahdoosheh, a young man from the city of Madaba, Jordan.  He started off with a mobile bookshop idea. He would drive around parts of Jordan in his old Mercedes, park, and set up his books on his car, and sell them to people. He dreamt of doing more related to books and reading and this eventually led to launching the social enterprise, Kawon. Brief about Kawon in his own words: Kawon Cultural Library is determined to become a daily place for locals to come to it, visitors from neighboring cities and tourists from all over the world, a place to dream and try to escape from the daily pressures of life and try something new, a comfortable place to meet your friends or read a book, all in one. With the increasing demand for high-quality coffee, food and great service, Kawon will benefit from its presence in the city of Madaba and the surrounding areas it serves, aiming to create a healthy environment, where cultural activities and knowledge exchange are the valves to evoke and spread new social values.

pads.title: Reusing fish farm pond water as fertilizer for crops
pads.snippet: Kaseb Al Shakanbeh from Dhiban, a small town in the governorate of Madaba in Jordan, owns and runs a fish farm and farm that grows vegetables and fruits and also has chicken and livestock. He has three fish ponds and 20% of the water in the fish ponds needs to be changed daily, which is 60 cubic meters per pond. Instead of throwing away the water, he is using it to water his crops. Since he now only uses this natural fertilizer and has stopped using hormones and other types of artificial fertilizers, the vegetables from his farm are now considered organic produce. He now has an increase in demand for his produce from vegetable shops and he is able to sell for double the price.

pads.title: Livestock and fish feed from leftover food
pads.snippet: Kaseb Al Shakhanbeh is testing the use of leftover food from local shops (like a cake shop) to make cheap feed for fish and livestock in his farm (which includes a fish farm). He saw this idea being tested in the West Bank, Palestine and decided to try it himself. What he is learning:  - This is saving him money in the operations of his own farm.   - The livestock feed has  shown to increase the percentage of protein in the animals to 40% (before it was 15%). This means he can sell the livestock for a higher price.  He is now testing this same approach for fish feed to see if it yields the same results.  - He is also trying tell the feed  to other farmers in winter because at that time of year there is no fresh grass so there is demand for the feed. He's selling a bag (not sure about weight) for 6 Jordanian Dinars per, which he says is good because it costs him zero JD to make the feed. Process of making the livestock feed: He takes leftover food from local shops for free Dries the food. Some foods need fermentation to get rid of toxinsC Crushes and mixes the different foods Adds corn to it Leaves it for 12 hours -3 days  Process of testing the fish feed: Take leftover food and dry it Type of food: meat from chicken, bones, protein sources, melt , crushed, Shapes it into circles  Challenges he faced: Needs hangar or caravan that is shielded from the sun and sanitized, which he can't afford. Currently using a tent which is not as hygienic. No tools to do it -having tools would make process faster. Using current method, 25 kilo per day, 3 people, 8 hours  With tools, you could make 4 times the amount   Not enough storage area. Currently storing by covering with fabric on wood so a good proportion goes to waste.

pads.title: Web/app que permite recopilar datos de informalidad laboral
pads.snippet:
Finalista del RETO DE INNOVACIÓN para crear un registro de jóvenes en informalidad lanzado en el marco del Proyecto SDG/ Laboratorio Aceleración Ecuador.


Es un prototipo para un sistema inteligente que permite recopilar datos de informalidad laboral para mejorar las oportunidades laborales de los jóvenes. Este sistema está dividido en cuatro partes importantes:


1. PROGRESSIVE WEB APP (PWA):
Esta aplicación ha sido diseñada para que los jóvenes tengan un espacio idóneo y muestren sus habilidades y conocimientos de su área de experticia al mundo. Todo esto acompañado de un asistente inteligente que brinda ofertas laborales ajustadas a cada uno de los perfiles en el caso que se requiera. Esta solución no solo ha sido

pensada para que los jóvenes encuentren trabajo sino que ellos puedan capacitarse día a día y estén preparados para el mundo laboral. Cuenta con una sección para que los jóvenes se capaciten de acuerdo a sus preferencias a través de cursos, blogs, consejos y post informativos para mejorar tanto sus habilidades técnicas como blandas.


La aplicación de DANIK cuenta con un sistema de PUSH NOTIFICATIONS automático para mantener al usuario informado y fidelizado con la plataforma. El sistema de notificaciones permite al usuario mantenerlo informado de noticias, ofertas laborales, eventos o consejos que le puedan servir en el día a día. Además, este sistema tiene la facultad de avisar cuando un nuevo cuestionario se ha creado, así el usuario estará informado en cualquier momento y la tasa de respuesta aumentará. El sistema de CORREO ELECTRÓNICO tiene el mismo fin mencionado
anteriormente pero se limita a informar sobre nuevos cuestionarios disponibles y noticias de carácter importante a la comunidad.


2. PANEL DE ADMINISTRACIÓN:
Este panel incluye:

· Crear, editar y publicar contenido informativo de manera sencilla.
· Manejo y administración de la página informativa (Landing Page).
· Manejo del sistema de PUSH NOTIFICATIONS.
· Estadísticas de la interacción con aplicación de los jóvenes (Rendimiento).
· Crear, editar y publicar encuestas fácilmente y en cualquier momento.
· Administración de la plataforma a través de roles de participación.


3. PANEL DE RECLUTAMIENTO:

Características destacadas:
· Filtro inteligente para buscar profesionales y no profesionales
· Comunicación directa con los jóvenes.
· Interfaz de usuario intuitiva para observar los portafolios de los jóvenes.
· Perfiles destacados.


4. DASHBOARD ESTADÍSTICO Y ACCESO A DATA WAREHOUSE

Características destacadas:
· Información relevante hallada a través de metodologías de Inteligencia deNegocios.
· Disponibilidad a la información 24/7.
· Facilidad de acceso a través de un sistema seguro (Contraseñas).
· Acceso a datos consolidados y homogéneos de forma segura a través de una API.
· Base de datos confiable para aplicar técnicas de analytics.

pads.title: Eggshells for clean water
pads.snippet: "H2O Lerma, water for all" is a project of a collective of scientists that seeks to contribute to the improvement of water quality and the reduction of heavy metals in the Lerma River. They carry out efforts of citizen collection of eggshells in schools, events and social networks of eggs. Later, they carry out the design and implementation of filters for heavy metals in the Lerma river. The project was created by Ivonne Linares Hernández, Elia Alejandra Teutli Sequeira, Guadalupe Vázquez Mejía, Guadalupe Fonseca Montes de Oca, Rosa María Fuentes Rivas and Verónica Martínez Miranda, professors and researchers at the Inter-American Institute of Technologies and Water Sciences and CONACyT, and it is developed in collaboration with residents of the city of Lerma.

pads.title: Citizen Science Sargassum Monitor - CollectiveView
pads.snippet:
Collective View is a citizen science project that seeks to complement traditional monitoring techniques, supporting validation points that allow Satellite Remote Sensing to improve its levels of precision.



The project has been developed by researchers from the Department of Observation and Study of the Earth, the Atmosphere and the Ocean of El Colegio de la Frontera Sur (ECOSUR), Chetumal unit, based on a collaborative scheme for the capture of images, algorithms of artificial intelligence for the automatic classification of photographs and geographic information systems for the visualization of results.



The main objective of the project is to generate distribution maps of sargassum along the beaches, using images collected and sent by the society. Through the use of an application available for mobile devices, the citizen can send images of the beach conditions. This information is stored on cloud servers and, later, the images are classified and processed so that various products can be produced, such as, for example, statistics of citizen participation by region or distribution maps of sargassum along the beach. , which in turn can support decision-making.

pads.title: Fair conditions for house workers
pads.snippet:
Network of women initiatives that support rights and social securities of household work. Their objectives and lines of work are:



- Make household work visible and to whom it is carried out.

- Generate a public debate on the value of this work and raise awareness about its important economic, social and social welfare functions in general.

- Promote the labor rights of domestic workers. Raise awareness that households are active agents to promote social justice.
- Promote that employer households guarantee the labor rights of domestic workers.

- Show that Mexican society is ready to take a step that the Mexican State has not yet wanted to take.

pads.title: Laboratoria, web training for women
pads.snippet: Laboratoria is an organization that provides a web development training program to young women who have not had access to quality higher education. In an intensive course, Laboratoria teaches participants to build web pages and applications, as well as helping them prepare for a job at a technology company. The goal is for young women to build successful careers and inspire thousands more women to follow in their footsteps. According to the organization, in Mexico there are more than five million young women who have not had the opportunity to access higher education and are not currently working either. On the other hand, with more and more Mexicans connecting to the Internet, the digital sector is growing and will continue to expand. In this context, the purpose of Laboratoria is to make web programming an agent of change for thousands of young women in Latin America.

pads.title: Ecological Charcoal from household and Agricultural Waste

pads.title: Hybrid Fruit and Vegetable dryer functional with Sun or Gaz
pads.snippet: A drying system for fruit and vegetables which conserves them in their natural form keeping it dry and can be consumed in seasons of lack. The sun is a healthy and renewable source of energy. Soukaina Bouba through this food conservation system intends to contribute to the food security in her community and limit food waste.

pads.snippet: In pictures, the smart shovel intended for any area where needed. This trash can is equipped with an electronic device that allows it to automate the opening and closing in the event of detection of the presence of 1 to 1.5m from the trash can, to remain locked and then send an alert SMS in case of filling.

pads.title: Prefabricated ecological stoves
pads.snippet: Prefabricated ecological stoves designed to replace the use of the traditional stove, that produces high smoke emissions that cause serious health problems. Mexican concrete company CEMEX manufactures the stoves with a clean technology design that concentrates heat in a closed and protected concrete compartment, and reduces smoke emissions inside the home by up to 99%. Efficiency: 65% reduction of wood / 1lt of water boils in 7' min. Lifetime: 15 years

pads.title: Barcoding to catalogue biodiversity in Galápagos
pads.snippet: Citizen science used to catalogue fauna and flora in the Galápagos. This project is led by Universidad San Francisco de Quito and has a 750.000 USD funding from: UK Research & Innovation (UKRI) del Reino Unido, Global Challenges Research Fund (GCRF) y Newton Fund. The project is starting by training 50 people who live in the Galápagos, who before the pandemic, had economic activities in tourism and fishing. This project helps reactivate their economy while contributing to conservation. These local people have been trained to use barcoding sytem, which consists on using DNA sequences and comparing that information to global databases. The limitation of this solution is that the project has a one year duration; however, sustainability is expected with new capacities acquired by local people who can continue with science and conservation. Data should be updated to identify endangered species, however, the project contributes to create an exhaustive catalogue.

pads.title: Water irrigation systems
pads.snippet:
Soluciones a la sequía gracias la iniciativa de mujeres de la Sierra ecuatoriana. Utilización de riego por goteo y por inundación mediante diques. El periódico GK realizó un fotoreportaje sobre estas soluciones comunitarias.

"Todas viven de la agricultura y necesitan agua para regar sus sembríos, donde pasan largas jornadas bajo un sol riguroso. Todas, todos los días hacen algo para llevar agua a sus tierras. Desde niñas ayudaban a sus padres campesinos y fueron aprendiendo, de a poco, el trabajo agrícola en esos valles secos rodeados de montañas secas. Pero lo que les enseñaron, hoy les funciona menos porque, según ellas, las temperaturas y la sequedad han empeorado.  

Blanca Atre, Adriana Tapia, Daisy Dota y Mélida Romero no saben con certeza qué es el cambio climático. Todos los días se adaptan a él pero desconocen que eso es lo que están haciendo con sus prácticas concretas para que las altas temperaturas, los soles intensos, la falta de lluvia y la sequedad del suelo no merme la producción de las cebollas, mangos, aguacates, limones, tomates, pepinos que cosechan para vivir."

https://gk.city/2020/02/17/adaptacion-cambio-climatico/

https://www.facebook.com/gkcityec/videos/las-mujeres-que-le-ganaron-al-desierto/566829044174624/

pads.title: Entrepatios: Housing cooperative
pads.snippet: Housing speculation makes it unaffordable to have adequate and decent housing to many families in Madrid. Mortgage legal framework is in favor of banks and posing 30-40 year debts to people. The solution: Entrepatios is the first eco-social housing cooperative in use rights in Madrid. •Collective property instead of individual property. •Participatory, climate and social responsible.

pads.title: Social-solidarity digital marketplace: La zona
pads.snippet: E-commerce brings solutions and problems. It becomes a problem when wealth is accumulated in a few giants (like Amazon). In Catalunya, Spain, during January-March 2021, “La Zona”, a platform made up of local, climate and environment resposible, cooperatives and association businesses, will be tested. From May-July will be running.

pads.title: Ilumexico, solar energy for remote communities
pads.snippet: Ilumexico offers access to clean and reliable energy, catalyzing the growth of Mexican families without access to electricity, which promotes positive changes in different areas of family life, particularly in educational, health, economic, safety, production, food refrigeration, and family leisure activities. Their process includes assessing the required innovation with the communities, offering access to inclusive financing, teaching how it works and can be installed/repaired, and ensuring access to parts and equipment. Website: https://ilumexico.mx Images: Ilumexico

pads.title: Tlaloque, rainwater filter
pads.snippet: Tlaloque, the first Mexican product of its kind, separates the dirtiest part of each rain so that it does not enter the cistern. The Tlaloque allows you to connect surfaces of up to 200 m2, for rural areas and 100m2 for urban areas, it also allows you to choose how many liters of rain you are going to separate.

pads.title: Cleaning the Nile
pads.snippet: VeryNile is the first initiative to develop sustainable means to clean the Nile while raising awareness on the importance of protecting our environment. VeryNile interlaces social and environmental impact and develops eco-friendly solutions to remove inorganic waste from the river.  The key activities of the initiative are:  - Cleaning (Socially and economically empowers local fishermen to clean the Nile on a daily basis, Launched the first cleaning boat in Africa. VeryNile I has been designed in Germany by the NGO One Earth One Ocean and built in Egypt thanks to their support. Finally, VeryNile organizes various clean-up events where volunteers can gather in one predetermined location to physically clean the banks of the Nile)   - Recycling (To make this project sustainable and to replicate and scale it elsewhere, collected recyclables are sold to recycling agencies. VeryNile is currently in the process of developing collaborations with various sectors to begin integrating Nile recyclables into new upcycled and recycled products.   - Preventing (Banning single use plastic bags in Zamalek, Awareness Campaigns, Developing Solid Waste Management Solutions)  - Social impact (Community Engagement, Job creation, Very Nile Hub) http://verynile.org/

pads.title: Caffé sospeso/ pending coffee
pads.snippet: It is a practice born in Naples, Italy, where coffee shop consumers pay in advance a cup of coffee for any poor person who can enter the shop asking for a cup of coffee. It promotes solidarity and the tradition has grown to other cities and countries where meals can also be "suspended". An anonymous citizen charity practice to combat hunger during economic crisis.

pads.title: Waste Recycle Bank
pads.snippet: Running by students of the Faculty of Environmental Sciences, National University of Laos, encouraging local people and students to separate trash especially plastic and recyclable materials and to deposit it at the bank for small incentives.

pads.title: Recycle Art Laos
pads.snippet: Recycle Art Laos is a micro business founded by two siblings in 2014. They tested how to turn office paper to become fine art works. Now they have many types of products which proved to be durable and easy to transport. They have a small home-based factory and hires a few staff. However, they work with the fine art students and provide them with jobs and fair pay. Their primary target group is foreign tourists. Due to Covid19, they have severely affected and now they want to develop new products which target more domestic consumers. They are registered as the national "One District One Product".

pads.title: Nahmdong Eco Plates
pads.snippet:
This local start-up was found in Luang Prabang in the northern part of Lao PDR. It is not a novel innovation in the world, but it is new to be produced and used in the country. The idea was introduced by the Indian tourists who visited the park which aimed to become environmentally friendly. At first, they planned to ban the use of plastic containers in their activity park, but it has received high interests for businesses in tourism sector. 
Issue they want to solve: 
Leaf plates and containers are optimal alternative plastic and polymer-based products. Most bamboo, palm, and areca sheaths are abandoned or burned everywhere. Therefore, the local villagers are encouraged to collect and sell these sheaths to exchange for some income.
Potential expansion: 
There is a possibility to produce machines with different moles in Lao PDR by collaborating with Faculty of Engineering, Technical Vocational Colleges. The initiative can turn into Sustainable Business Model by generating income in the community and creating jobs by forming a group or cooperative. It can be connected with other development projects in country and the region which support the production of rattan and bamboo and livelihoods for income generation scattering across the countries by government and NGOs.

pads.title: Teenah -tote bags for impact
pads.snippet: We are a social manufacturing company that produces high-quality custom printed bags and other textile-based products creating jobs for Syrian refugee women and Jordanian women in the north of Jordan.

pads.title: Greening the Desert Project
pads.snippet: The Greening the Desert Project is living proof that we can reverse desertification and bring back life to desolate barren lands. By living in harmony with nature and applying permaculture design practices to the landscape the possibilities are endless. https://www.greeningthedesertproject.org/

pads.title: Overcoming the digital gap for the elderly
pads.snippet: Due to COVID 19 restrictions that also impacted on mobilization,  the "ice-cream grandpas" where facing a higher challenge, how to sell their ice-creams by walking around with their mobile carts, in the urban areas and manage to go back and forth to their homes when public transportation went off and the working hours were very limited in the country. So the social network group "Ayúdame a Trabajar" notice their problem and suggested to bring food to the warehouse the elderly kept the carts to help them to survive. Some of them couldn´t commute back to their homes.  A young lady, María Isabel, came to help them no only providing groceries or health prevention items, but she created a Facebook page "Abuelitos Heladeros" with e-commerce link where packages of ice-creams  from these group of "grandpas", could be sell through the page to help them to keep running their discrete business. Many people who knew about them started buying them many packages and collaborating either with groceries, money donations or other  useful items including medic assistance. Maria Isabel with the help of family and friends raised more funds to refurbish the warehouse and open it as a residential option for them too. The initiative has grown, and now they are helping other elder that are facing rough conditions.  Probably the main success key factor is that María Isabel has published all the expenses of the funds the FBPage has raised.

The site has been active since then. Actually other small social ideas/responses have come up from this network "Ayúdame a Trabajar" and they are quite successful.

pads.title: Citizen science on sanitation and waste management: "Mi hábitat: observando con lupa mi barrio"
pads.snippet:
Description of citizen participation: Workshops were conducted to identify potential sanitation issues existing in participants’ neighborhoods. Based on such issues, an app was adapted, and possible preventive measures were discussed.  At said workshops, the following main issues were identified: 

· Dumping sites

· Reuse of certain materials

· Compost made from organic waste

Within 15 days, young people grouped in work teams sent—using the app— images showing areas of their neighborhood, mostly photos of dumping sites and rodents, which pose potential health risks to their communities. Once neighborhood mapping was completed by the work teams, workshops were conducted to discuss findings and possible management actions.

The pump automatically comes on when water level in the tank is at 25% and turns off when full at 100%. It has a colour coded display which indicates the various water levels.

pads.snippet: Our technology SoWind (solar & windmill combine) uses sun light and wind to power homes and small businesses in rural communities. We install this technology to provide cheap and affordable electricity for the less privilege citizens of Sierra Leone, the combination of the solar and windmill makes the systems more effective because it works during the day and night.

pads.title: Auto-irrigation
pads.snippet: This system is powered by a solar panel and battery. The system has a submissive pump, a reservoir tank and pipes. The solar panel and batteries power the submissive pump which pulls the water from the reservoir/source and pumps it through the pipes. The system is also designed with an automatic switching system which is programmed with a mobile phone with a range of over 5000 miles away, this means that the farmer can be at his or her home and irrigate their farm.

pads.title: Agro fish farm
pads.snippet: Agro Fish Farm is company that is engaged in fish farming business. Our major challenge is the lack of fish feed and unfortunate for us we do not have anyone that is producing it in Sierra Leone. So for that reason our solution is a simple and smart method to manage biodegradable waste, while at the same time providing organic and healthy animal feed and fertilizer at cheaper prices. We collect the degradable waste, which is typically household waste such unwanted leftover food and kitchen waste, and place it in a moisture container and leave an opening that allows the black soldier fly to come in and feed on the waste. In that process, they will lay eggs that grow into maggots. The overall process takes one week and the amount of waste the black soldier fly eats is proportional to the maggot it produces. This maggot can then begin to serve as feed for animals such chickens, duck and even in production of fish feed.

pads.title: The House of Elder Artists: unretirement home
pads.snippet:
Women´s movements have conquered rights and transformed the lives of women and girls; however, aging process has been left almost unquestioned.
While we participate in an endless number of activities, when aging, we´re left with little choices other than private solutions: either payed residences or care services, or family based caregiving.


The House of Elder Artists, or Thea, a cooperative of women writers, artists, community activists have organized an unretirement home. It is a nonprofit residence and cultural center in Manhattan with 100 rental apartments, many reserved for people of low to modest means. It has a partenership with the Women's Housing and  Economic Development Corporation, a nonprofit organization dedicated to  women's housing issues.

pads.title: Filtration d'eau de boisson à partir du moringa
pads.snippet: A travers Bio Niger, Sahabi Souley a mis en place une méthode innovante de filtration d'eau à partir des feuilles de moringa, plante répandue au Niger. Constatant que les producteurs de moringa avaient du mal à écouler leur production dans la région de Tahoua, d'où il est originaire, M. Souley a mis au point une technique innovante de filtration des impuretés présentes dans l'eau grâce aux feuilles de moringa, aux propriétés reconnues. Il utilise des feuilles de moringa cultivées sans pesticides ni engrais chimiques pour filtrer l'eau, conditionnée sous forme de sachets (à l'image des sachets d'eau potable que l'on peut trouver dans les marchés). Un effort est fait sur l'emballage, constitué d'un plastique recyclé qui se dégrade plus rapidement qu'un plastique classique (sans toutefois atteindre le biodégradable). Permettant aux producteurs de moringa d'écouler leur surplus de production, la mise au point de cette méthode naturelle de filtration de l'eau, qui peut être réalisée avec des infrastructures de base et ne nécessite pas d'équipements spécifiques, facilite également l'accès à une eau propre aux populations reculées. L'innovation a été mise au point et développée dans la région de Tahoua, avec des équipements sommaires - avant de se déplacer à Niamey pour envisager une production à plus grande échelle.

pads.title: Amazon Fire Tracker
pads.snippet:
"An innovative new app for Real-time Amazon Fire Monitoring (see MAAP #118 for details).


In a novel approach, the app combines data from the  atmosphere (aerosol emissions in smoke) and the ground (heat anomaly  alerts) to effectively detect and visualize major Amazon fires.




The app specializes in filtering out thousands of  the heat-based fire alerts to prioritize only those burning large 
amounts of biomass and thus emitting elevated levels of aerosol (defined here as a major fire)."

pads.title: Despatronados
pads.snippet:
Despatronados is the Portuguese (Spanish) word to  "Boss-less". This is a powerful solution to exploitation, precarity, unsafe work in delivery jobs such as Uber, Glovo, etc.


Delivery workers in Río de Janeiro, Brazil got together to organize themselves into a delivery cooperative with no hiearchies and fair pay. Their work is not mediated by an app, but instead they have decided to build a network together with clients based on trust. "From workers to workers". https://despatronados.wixsite.com/cooperativa?fbclid=IwAR09v1eFlnMwRkt9Zr8hEdnWmHve5OCeFjr2NLTPCXYGd9Uw_0h9bDY58sM

pads.title: Farmers organization: APEOSAE
pads.snippet:
“I was born to a rural and humble home. I was always my mother´s the 
head of the household. Knowing the needs of farming people and their 
exploitation, I proposed myself to create a second level organization 
called APEOASAE. We dedicate ourselves to ecological farming and we even

pads.title: Carishinas en bici
pads.snippet:
"Carishinas" is a Quichua word, which in Spanish has become popular to describe women and girls who don´t fit into traditional roles. Women who don´t cook well, who like to play outdoors and do "male" activities are disdainly called "carishinas". Honoring this term, a group of women have organized the collective "Carishinas on Bicycles". This citizen organization aims to reclaim public spaces for women who can freely transport themselves on bicycles. Ecuador is not Amsterdam, so access to a male, car dominated public space is quite a challenge.
Because of traditional roles, many adult women do not know how to ride bikes. This women´s collective teaches women to ride bikes, and hit the road! Group biking are organized.
This experience was storytold in Human Library event organized by Ecuador AccLab in January.

pads.title: Dogs against gender violence
pads.snippet:
This solution was created by Andrea Mosquera who shared her experience in the Human Library event organized by Ecuador´s Acclab in January. Andrea is a woman with disability (cerebral palsy) who was assaulted in a park by a man who had followed her. When she was brought down to the floor, suddenly a dog approached them and barked insistently to the point that the attacker had to let her go. Her story: https://acclabecu.org/en/a-four-legged-hero/

From this experience, Andrea Funded ARNV (Non-violence Rapid Action), a foundation that trains street dogs to protect battered women who have a restraining order.
